summary: This article explores the concept of "serverless data centers" by combining serverless computing and hardware disaggregation. It explains how serverless computing allows developers to focus on application code by abstracting infrastructure management, while hardware disaggregation breaks down monolithic servers into pools of specialized resources. The author argues that true serverless data centers, leveraging disaggregated hardware, will enable flexible and efficient resource allocation tailored precisely to application needs.

title: S&P 500 Buybacks Decline 21.8% as Financials Pull Back; 12-Months Buybacks Pass $1 Trillion for the First Time
summary: S&P 500 stock buybacks decreased by 21.8% in Q2 2022 to $219.6 billion from Q1's record $281.0 billion, primarily due to a pullback from Financials and Health Care sectors. Despite the quarterly decline, the 12-month expenditure ending June 2022 surpassed $1 trillion for the first time, reaching $1.005 trillion, a 65.0% increase from the prior year. An anticipated 1% excise tax on net buybacks in 2023 is not expected to significantly impact overall buyback activity in 2023, though some 2023 purchases may be accelerated into Q4 2022.

title: Palo Alto close to buying Israeli cyber co Apiiro
summary: US cybersecurity firm Palo Alto Networks is reportedly close to acquiring Israeli cybersecurity company Apiiro for over $550 million. This would mark Palo Alto's eighth acquisition in Israel, continuing its strategy of integrating Israeli tech startups. Apiiro, founded in 2019, specializes in identifying risks in cloud-based applications early in the development process, an approach known as "Shift Left."

title: Slack’s brand-new feature has an unexpectedly rich backstory
summary: Slack has launched a new feature called "canvas," which is based on technology from Quip, a company acquired by Salesforce. This feature aims to provide a flexible, interactive tool for sharing information within Slack, fulfilling a long-held vision of Slack's cofounder and CEO Stewart Butterfield. Canvas allows for collaborative document creation and organization, addressing a gap in Slack's previous capabilities for persistent information sharing and long-term project documentation.

title: S|W: The SaaS Weekly – Adobe has $20 billion designs on Figma
summary: This edition of S|W: The SaaS Weekly highlights Adobe's significant $20 billion acquisition of Figma and Google facing a $25 billion lawsuit. The newsletter also covers various funding rounds for Canadian startups like GrowerIQ and Bright, leadership changes at Thinkific, and financial updates from companies like D2L and Byju's, alongside news of layoffs at GoStudent and Twilio.

title: Logitech G Elevates Game Streaming By Unveiling Cloud First Handheld Gaming Device
summary: Logitech G has launched the G CLOUD Gaming Handheld, a dedicated cloud gaming device developed in partnership with Tencent Games. This device is optimized for cloud streaming from Xbox Game Pass Ultimate and NVIDIA GeForce NOW, offering precision controls, a 1080p HD screen, and over 12 hours of battery life. It will be available in North America in October 2022 for a suggested retail price of $349.99, with a limited-time pre-order price of $299.99.

title: Schlumberger Launches Enterprise Data Solution
summary: Schlumberger announced the commercial release of its Enterprise Data Solution, powered by Microsoft Energy Data Services. This solution, aligned with the OSDU™ Technical Standard, aims to provide comprehensive subsurface data capabilities and enable data integration across multiple vendors. It supports data-driven decision-making, accelerates AI and digital solutions, and is designed to improve operational efficiency and advance initiatives like carbon capture, utilization, and storage (CCUS).

title: XAIX ETF Price and Chart — TRADEGATE:XAIX
summary: This article provides detailed information on the Xtrackers Artificial Intelligence & Big Data UCITS ETF (XAIX), including its price, key statistics, fund information, and investment profile. It covers assets under management, expense ratio, inception date, index tracked, and breakdowns by asset class and region. The article also addresses frequently asked questions about ETFs and XAIX specifically.

title: Herbalife Nutrition Survey Reveals Top Ten Modern Day Entrepreneurs and What Traits are Needed to Join the List
summary: A Herbalife Nutrition survey identified Bill Gates, Jeff Bezos, and Steve Jobs as the top three most influential modern entrepreneurs, followed by Elon Musk and Mark Zuckerberg. The study, involving 2,750 respondents across the U.S., Mexico, and Israel, also explored traits essential for entrepreneurial success, highlighting creativity and intelligence as most important. Herbalife Nutrition emphasized the ongoing strength of the entrepreneurial spirit and the company's commitment to fostering it.

title: R2 is now Generally Available
summary: Cloudflare announced the general availability of R2, its object storage service. R2 differentiates itself by eliminating egress fees, addressing a major cost concern for developers using traditional cloud providers. The service offers S3 compatibility, automatic regional optimization, integration with Cloudflare Workers, and transparent pricing based on storage volume and operation types, with a free tier for initial usage.

title: 'Productivity paranoia': Microsoft study of corporate workplaces finds big disconnect in hybrid work
summary: A new Microsoft study reveals a significant "productivity paranoia" gap between employees and leaders regarding hybrid work. While 87% of employees feel productive, only 12% of leaders are confident in their employees' productivity, creating a disconnect that could threaten the sustainability of hybrid work. Microsoft suggests focusing on outcomes, clear communication, and continuous feedback, rather than monitoring hours, and is updating its Viva platform with features to address these challenges.

title: How a Top Fidelity Growth Fund Is Navigating This Market
summary: Fidelity Growth Discovery FDSVX, co-managed by Jason Weiner and Asher Anolic, has navigated 2022's challenging market for growth stocks better than many peers by focusing on "growth quality" rather than simply high-growth potential. The fund emphasizes companies with strong gross margins and predictable earnings growth, incorporating names like Microsoft, Coca-Cola, and UnitedHealth Group, which are not typically associated with aggressive growth funds. This strategy has helped the fund outperform its category over various timeframes despite the overall market downturn.

title: Palo Alto brings next-gen firewall to Azure Marketplace
summary: Palo Alto Networks has made its VM-Series Next-Generation Firewall (NGFW) software available on Microsoft's Azure Marketplace, aiming to secure private Azure-based 4G and 5G Multi-Access Edge Computing (MEC) installations. This solution promises faster time to market for Azure customers, simpler deployment at scale, and protection against zero-day vulnerabilities. Key features include a unified management console, network segmentation, automatic scaling, sandboxing, and support for the OSI Layer 7 network security model.

title: What Is Moonlighting? Here’s Why Wipro Fired 300 Employees For Doing It
summary: Wipro has terminated approximately 300 employees for "moonlighting," specifically for working with rival companies while still on Wipro's payroll. This move comes as the IT services firm takes a firm stance against employees holding second jobs. The issue of moonlighting has sparked debate in the IT industry, with some companies like IBM and Infosys warning against it due to concerns about integrity, productivity, and confidentiality, while others like Tech Mahindra express openness to the practice under certain conditions.

title: Take-Two Interactive patent could point to a bigger, better world for the next Grand Theft Auto
summary: A recently filed patent by Take-Two Interactive, "System And Method For Virtual Navigation In A Gaming Environment," suggests significant advancements in simulating large-scale urban environments in video games. The patent outlines an approach to offload virtual navigation tasks to the cloud, improving the realism and complexity of NPC and vehicle behavior. This technology could have a profound impact on future Grand Theft Auto titles, though the article notes the patent doesn't specifically mention the franchise.

title: DPSP Group partners with Vivo to digitize the company's telephone service
summary: DPSP Group, parent company of Drogarias Pacheco and Drogaria São Paulo, has partnered with Vivo Empresas to digitize its telephone service. Vivo will provide a Virtual PABX system, enabling over 5,000 branches to operate from anywhere and integrate with collaboration tools like Microsoft Teams. This aims to optimize internal processes, improve efficiency, and enhance customer satisfaction for the pharmaceutical retail giant.

title: Shrugging off crypto winter, Galaxy Digital’s Mike Novogratz calls inaugural NFT launch ‘building for the future’
summary: Despite the ongoing "crypto winter" and declining NFT sales, Galaxy Digital CEO Mike Novogratz remains bullish on NFTs, launching the company's inaugural collection of 3,210 digital collectibles. The NFTs, created in partnership with Time's Web3 initiative TIMEPieces, will be airdropped for free to employees and partners, with Novogratz emphasizing it as "building for the future" and a way to foster community spirit rather than a financial endeavor. He points to corporate adoption of NFTs by companies like Nike and the NBA as evidence of their long-term viability.

title: Microsoft (MSFT) Dividend Stock Analysis
summary: Microsoft (MSFT) recently increased its quarterly dividend by 9.67% to 68 cents/share, marking 17 consecutive years of dividend increases. The company's earnings per share have grown significantly, supported by share buybacks and future growth expected from its Azure cloud platform, Office software-as-a-service, LinkedIn, Xbox, and strategic acquisitions like Activision Blizzard. Despite the stock trading at a high valuation, the author plans to add to their position, anticipating solid returns and yields on cost over the next decade.

title: Ontario Power Generation enters agreement to sell clean energy credits to Microsoft
summary: Ontario Power Generation (OPG) has signed a 10-year agreement to sell clean energy credits from its hydroelectric dams and nuclear reactors to Microsoft. This deal marks OPG's first major customer for its clean energy credit trading business and will help Microsoft meet its goal of powering its operations with 100% zero-carbon energy by 2030, particularly for its data centers and offices in Ontario. The sale of nuclear-derived credits has, however, sparked debate among environmental groups and the Ontario Energy Board regarding the definition of "clean" energy and the potential implications of selling these credits outside the province.

title: Artificial Intelligence at Dow Chemical - Two Use Cases at the World's Largest Chemical Company
summary: Dow Chemical, the world's third-largest chemical company, is leveraging AI to address significant business challenges. This article details two key AI use cases: automating and predicting polyurethane fitting for customized products and detecting containment leaks in its chemical plants using computer vision. These initiatives, developed in partnership with Microsoft, aim to enhance product development efficiency and improve safety standards.

title: OPG and Microsoft announce strategic partnership to power a Net-Zero future for Ontario
summary: Ontario Power Generation (OPG) and Microsoft have formed a strategic partnership in Canada to tackle climate change and promote sustainable growth in Ontario. Microsoft will purchase Clean Energy Credits (CECs) from OPG's carbon-free hydro and nuclear assets on an hourly basis, aiming for 100% carbon-free energy for its datacenters globally by 2030. The collaboration also includes co-developing an hourly energy matching platform, modernizing OPG's IT infrastructure with Microsoft Azure, and exploring digital co-innovation for OPG's Small Modular Reactor program.

title: 삼성자산운용, 월배당 'DIVO ETF' 한국판 출시
summary: 삼성자산운용이 미국 운용사 앰플리파이의 월배당 커버드콜 ETF인 'DIVO'의 한국판 상품을 출시한다. 이 상품은 'KODEX 미국 배당 프리미엄 액티브 ETF'로, 미국 우량 배당 성장주와 대표 성장주에 투자하며 주식 배당과 콜옵션 매도를 통해 월 배당 재원을 마련한다. 특히 개별 주식에 대한 전략적인 콜옵션 매도와 자산의 주가 상승에 따른 자본 이익 추구하는 액티브 전략이 특징이다.

title: University of Doha for Science and Technology signs an MoU with Microsoft Skilling and Innovation at the core of the agreement – Middle East & Africa News Center
summary: The University of Doha for Science and Technology (UDST) has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Microsoft to foster collaboration in information technology and digital skilling. This partnership aims to integrate Microsoft's technologies into UDST's curriculum, provide training for students and faculty, and enhance career development for students. The agreement emphasizes a commitment to advancing knowledge and building digital skills in Qatar.

title: Build real-time video and audio apps on the world’s most interconnected network
summary: Cloudflare announced Cloudflare Calls, a new product designed to simplify the development of real-time audio and video applications. This service abstracts away WebRTC complexities by leveraging Cloudflare's global network as a "super peer," offering a regionless, scalable, and secure solution for applications like video conferencing, interactive events, and privacy-first group sessions. Calls aims to solve common challenges with traditional WebRTC deployments, such as high latency, reliability issues with multiple participants, and the operational overhead of managing SFUs, by routing traffic through the closest Cloudflare data center and providing enhanced observability and privacy features.

title: Nvidia, Rigetti Team on Quantum Hybrid Climate Modeling
summary: Rigetti Computing announced new partnerships and progress on its product roadmap at its inaugural investor day. Notable collaborations include a partnership with Nvidia for quantum hybrid climate modeling using quantum machine learning, integration with Microsoft Azure Quantum for its processors, and a collaboration with Keysight for error mitigation software. Rigetti also detailed its advancements in modular dilution fridges and released new 80-qubit and 40-qubit processors.

title: Budget cuts will spare IT heading into 2023
summary: Despite widespread concerns about a prolonged economic downturn and anticipated budget cuts in 2023, IT spending is expected to remain robust. A survey of over 1,400 IT professionals by Spiceworks Ziff Davis indicates that most companies plan to increase their tech budgets, with only a small percentage looking to reduce IT spending. This trend suggests that companies view technology investments, particularly in modernization and cloud services, as crucial hedges against economic instability, even as they trim non-essential spending elsewhere.

title: John Hancock U.S. High Dividend ETF ETF Price, Holdings, & News (NYSEARCA:JHDV)
summary: The John Hancock U.S. High Dividend ETF (JHDV) was launched on September 27, 2022, and focuses on actively managed high dividend-paying or high dividend growth stocks of US large- and mid-cap companies. The ETF has assets under management of $10.94 million and a net expense ratio of 0.34%, with its stock price having increased by 19.5% since January 1, 2026. Its top holdings include NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Apple, indicating a significant allocation to major technology companies.

title: Lazard Asset Management: 3 undervalued global equities
summary: Warryn Robertson from Lazard Asset Management identifies three undervalued global equities: eBay, Intel, and International Game Technology (IGT). He explains that eBay and Intel are attractively priced after significant declines, having refocused their strategies and invested heavily in R&D, respectively. IGT is highlighted for its strong, underappreciated earnings growth and low valuation compared to its peers.

title: Salesforce Inc. stock rises Wednesday, still underperforms market
summary: Salesforce Inc. stock rose 0.86% on Wednesday to $150.17, despite an overall positive day for the stock market where the S&P 500 and Dow Jones also saw gains. However, the company's stock still underperformed several key competitors, including Microsoft, Adobe, and SAP SE. Salesforce Inc. remains significantly below its 52-week high.

title: Tims China Completes Business Combination with Silver Crest Acquisition Corporation
summary: Tims China has completed its business combination with Silver Crest Acquisition Corporation, which is expected to provide nearly $200 million for continued growth. The combined company will be named TH International Limited, with shares and warrants trading on NASDAQ under "THCH" and "THCHW." Tims China aims to build a profitable network of 2,750 stores by 2026, supported by this new funding and strategic partnerships.

title: 12 tips for mitigating cyberattacks
summary: This article by JPMorgan Chase provides 12 recommendations for organizations to mitigate cyberattacks, drawing on best practices from the National Security Agency (NSA). The tips cover areas such as software updates, account access control, disaster recovery planning, network segregation, and leveraging multi-factor authentication. The article emphasizes the importance of continuous review, updates, and proactive defensive strategies in a constantly evolving cyberthreat landscape.

title: N-able’s David Weeks: When Partners Grow, We Grow
summary: David Weeks, senior director of partner experience for N-able, discusses the company's strategies for 2023, emphasizing deep relationships with partners, investments in cloud and security, and new offerings like N-sights RMM and the cloud user hub. He highlights N-able's focus on automation and education, aiming to help MSPs with efficiency and talent shortages, and views industry consolidation as a positive for the MSP space. Weeks also touches on the upcoming Empower conference, which will focus heavily on education and peer-to-peer learning.

title: Microsoft Corp. stock outperforms market despite losses on the day
summary: Microsoft Corp. (MSFT) shares decreased by 1.48% to $237.50 on Thursday, still outperforming the broader market which saw the S&P 500 fall by 2.11% and the Dow Jones Industrial Average fall by 1.54%. The stock closed significantly below its 52-week high, but performed better than some competitors like Apple, Alphabet, and SAP SE ADR. Trading volume for Microsoft exceeded its 50-day average.

title: Microsoft recognized as a Leader in the 2022 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Cloud ERP for Product-Centric Enterprises
summary: Microsoft has been recognized as a Leader in the 2022 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Cloud ERP for Product-Centric Enterprises for the second consecutive year. This recognition is attributed to their Completeness of Vision and Ability to Execute, with Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management and Dynamics 365 Finance highlighted for their cloud-native architecture, integration with the Microsoft technology stack, embedded analytics, and flexible manufacturing capabilities. Microsoft continues to invest in innovation to make Dynamics 365 smarter and more efficient for enterprises of all scales.

title: SIA Applauds Appointment of Industry Leaders to Advise Commerce Department on CHIPS R&D Implementation
summary: The Semiconductor Industry Association (SIA) has praised the U.S. Commerce Department's selection of an Industrial Advisory Committee (IAC). This committee, comprised of 24 industry leaders, will guide the Secretary of Commerce on semiconductor research and development related to the CHIPS for America Act. SIA emphasizes the importance of collaboration between government, industry, and academia to effectively implement the act's R&D investments and boost U.S. semiconductor innovation.

title: The Walt Disney Company appoints Media and Technology Executive Carolyn Everson to its board of directors
summary: The Walt Disney Company announced the appointment of Carolyn Everson, a veteran media and technology executive, to its Board of Directors, effective November 21. Everson has held senior roles at companies like Instacart, Facebook (Meta), Microsoft, and Viacom. Her extensive experience in digital advertising and consumer-facing organizations is expected to provide valuable perspective for Disney's global growth and strategic priorities.

title: Cash App, Walmart, iPhone 14, Apple, and Intuit — Top Scams and Phishing Schemes of the Week
summary: This article highlights prevalent scams impersonating major brands like Cash App, Walmart, Apple, and Intuit. Scammers use phishing links in emails and text messages to lure victims into fake online surveys or login pages, aiming to steal personal information and financial details. The article emphasizes the importance of verifying URLs, sender addresses, and avoiding unknown links, while also promoting Trend Micro's security tools as protection against these threats.

title: Lloyds Bank closing Copley data center in 2025
summary: Lloyds Banking Group plans to close its Copley, West Yorkshire data center in 2025 as part of a modernization strategy and ongoing cloud migration. The bank had previously announced a £60 million plan for its Halifax Bank unit's HQ, which included the closure of the Copley facility. Lloyds has been moving workloads to the cloud, signing a large deal with IBM in 2017 and later with Azure and Google Cloud.

title: Here are the people who texted Elon Musk to offer advice or money for the Twitter deal
summary: This article details text messages between Elon Musk and various tech and media luminaries concerning his bid to buy Twitter. The exchanges reveal advice, investment offers, and discussions about the platform's future, as shared in court documents related to Musk's attempt to back out of the $44 billion acquisition. Notable texters include Jack Dorsey, Larry Ellison, Joe Lonsdale, and Sam Bankman-Fried.

title: TTAC: Overweight Tech & Energy, Underweight Industrials & Communication
summary: The FCF US Quality ETF (TTAC) focuses on free cash flow to select approximately 150 stocks, aiming to outperform the Russell 3000. As of late August, TTAC was overweight in technology and energy sectors and underweight in industrials and communication services. FCF Advisors prioritizes free cash flow metrics, which they believe are more difficult to manipulate than GAAP earnings, especially in the current challenging investment environment.

title: Advancing Digitization Puts Spotlight on GTEK ETF
summary: The Goldman Sachs Future Tech Leaders Equity ETF (GTEK) is highlighted as a strong option for investors looking to capitalize on the ongoing trend of digitization. The article emphasizes GTEK's active management approach, which allows it to adapt quickly to emerging trends, especially in sectors like cloud computing, digital transformation, and cybersecurity, which benefit even during inflationary periods. The ETF, with 58 holdings and $215 million in assets, is also noted for its exposure to semiconductor companies, poised to benefit from supply chain reshoring efforts.

title: Ocean Network Express charts course as a data-driven enterprise
summary: Ocean Network Express (ONE) has embarked on a digital transformation journey to become a data-driven enterprise. This initiative involves leveraging digital technologies, public cloud, and integrated data platforms, undertaken in partnership with DXC Technology. The case study details ONE's move to the cloud and its strategic, standardized approach to company-wide modernization.

title: 'Ask the Expert' with Dominic Mailhot from Export Development Canada (EDC) – Microsoft News Center Canada
summary: This article features an interview with Dominic Mailhot, CIO of Export Development Canada (EDC), as part of Microsoft's "Ask the Expert" series. Mailhot discusses EDC's top priority: helping Canadian businesses become more competitive through strong sustainability practices and ESG goals. He highlights EDC's own digital transformation, including migrating to Azure, to lead by example in reducing environmental impact and supporting a low-carbon economy.

title: ServiceNow Continues to Grow Its Revenue, But Can It Catch Up to Microsoft?
summary: ServiceNow has experienced significant growth since its 2012 IPO, with its revenue increasing from less than $650 million to $5.9 billion in 2021, representing a 42.5% CAGR. While the company projects continued strong growth, it faces a challenge in catching up to Microsoft, which, despite a more modest 11% CAGR in the same period, has a much larger revenue base. ServiceNow, with its cloud-based digital workflow management platform, is a major player in its industry but is unlikely to surpass the much older and larger Microsoft by 2030.

title: Waymo, C.H. Robinson Driverless Trucks Haul Beer to Houston From Dallas
summary: Waymo, Alphabet's driverless-vehicle unit, and C.H. Robinson have completed a pilot program hauling over 1 million pounds of Modelo and Corona beer from Dallas to Houston using Class 8 trucks with Waymo's self-driving software and a safety driver. This test demonstrates the system's maturity and performance, potentially addressing the long-haul driver shortage for C.H. Robinson and commercializing Waymo's autonomous vehicle technology. The companies are working towards deploying service without a test driver in the coming years.

title: Trade Desk (Nasdaq:TTD) - Stock Analysis
summary: The Trade Desk (TTD) is currently trading 34.1% below Simply Wall St's fair value estimate of US$29.24, experiencing a challenging period with a 72.6% stock price decline over the past year. Despite strong financial health scores and projected annual earnings growth of 10.65%, the company faces risks such as significant insider selling, executive turnover, client audit concerns, and competitive pressures. Recent news indicates investment in AI and international growth alongside softer near-term guidance.

title: Your company might one day have its own internal podcast. Here’s why
summary: Internal podcasts are gaining traction as a creative solution for companies to communicate with their increasingly remote and dispersed workforces. Brands like DoorDash and Arlo have successfully launched internal podcasts to keep employees connected, share company updates, facilitate training, and foster a sense of community. The trend, significantly accelerated by the pandemic, offers an attractive alternative to traditional communication methods like long emails or mandatory meetings, providing employees with flexible access to information and engagement.

title: The BMO Voluntary Carbon Market Primer – 4 Major Takeaways
summary: BMO Capital Markets released a report on the voluntary carbon market (VCM), predicting substantial growth contingent on high-integrity carbon credits. The report projects the VCM to reach 6.5x its 2020 volume by 2030 and 17.4x by 2050, highlighting the necessity of carbon removal offsets and a direct correlation between pricing and credit quality. It also emphasizes the influential role of corporate offsetting guidelines in shaping the market's future and the importance of transparent disclosure from companies like Microsoft.

title: Lucid Software Integrates with ServiceNow to Increase Optimization Across Application Portfolios
summary: Lucid Software has announced a new integration with ServiceNow, combining Lucidchart with ServiceNow's Application Portfolio Management (APM) solution. This integration uses Lucid's expanded API to automatically generate Lucidchart diagrams from ServiceNow APM data, allowing users to visualize dependencies and optimization opportunities. The collaboration aims to streamline workflows and enhance productivity by bringing visual collaboration into existing enterprise tech stacks.

title: How the NetApp/VMware Partnership Benefits Businesses in the Cloud
summary: The partnership between NetApp and VMware aims to help businesses overcome cloud overspending and improve storage solutions. It allows organizations to manage cloud storage consistently, integrate cloud services without major overhauls, and procure storage incrementally based on their needs. This collaboration offers flexibility and cost-efficiency for businesses utilizing cloud environments.

title: Cathie Wood bought up Tesla shares after a Monday stock plunge. They quickly rebounded.
summary: Cathie Wood's Ark Investment Management LLC purchased 132,213 shares of Tesla on Monday, marking her firm's first buy since mid-June after a significant stock decline. This dip-buying activity led to a quick rebound in Tesla's shares by as much as 4% on Tuesday, contributing to S&P 500 gains. The purchase indicates a renewed strategy of buying the dip after a year of selling down her stake in the EV manufacturer, whose shares had previously lost their "crown jewel" status in her main fund.

title: Identity Theft Monitoring Offered to Microsoft 365 Consumer Users
summary: Microsoft has launched a new Identity Theft Monitoring service for its U.S. Microsoft 365 Personal and Family subscribers, offered at no extra charge. The service is largely outsourced to Experian, which provides up to $1 million in insurance for stolen funds and $100,000 for identity theft. Users will need to provide personal information to Experian, not Microsoft, to utilize the monitoring service.

title: What’s up with… InterDigital, Orange, Calix
summary: InterDigital announced improved Q3 financial guidance and a new 7-year licensing deal with Apple worth $938 million, sending its stock up. Orange initiated an energy-saving plan in France for the winter, while Calix appointed Michael Weening as its new CEO. The article also touches on other telecom news, including a Telstra data breach, Vodafone M&A activity, BSNL's 5G plans with TCS, and Lumen Technologies' $7.5 billion ILEC sale.

title: Security to take an outsized role in IT spending in 2023
summary: Security is projected to take an outsized role in IT spending in 2023, encompassing larger shares of software, hardware, and cloud budgets, according to a Spiceworks Ziff Davis survey. Despite potential recessionary concerns leading to cuts in other areas, companies are increasing tech budgets, with cybersecurity identified as a major line item. This prioritization reflects a learned behavior from modernization efforts, viewing cyber spend as a smart investment to mitigate risks from older systems and evolving threat landscapes.

title: Uber asks employees to return to office twice a week
summary: Uber Technologies Inc. will require employees to work from the office two days a week, designating Tuesdays and Thursdays as "anchor days" starting November 1st. This move comes as many companies adjust to hybrid working models, though Uber will still allow employees to work remotely for up to four weeks annually. Previously, the company had a more flexible policy allowing staff to work remotely up to half the time.

title: iShares Russell 3000 ETF IWV
summary: This article provides details on the iShares Russell 3000 ETF (IWV), including its current price, key metrics, and how to invest in it through the eToro platform. It highlights that the ETF aims to replicate the performance of the Russell 3000 Index, encompassing major US companies like Apple, Microsoft, and Amazon. The piece also includes trending ETFs and educational resources on ETF investing.

title: Building a Lifelong Learning Culture Is More Important Than Ever
summary: In an era of rapid technological advancement and job market evolution, fostering a culture of lifelong learning is crucial for both individuals and organizations. Automation and AI are transforming roles, necessitating continuous skill development to remain relevant. Employees are eager to upskill, and organizations that fail to provide learning opportunities risk losing talent, making lifelong learning a critical component for future success, emphasizing reward, leadership support, awareness, and technology enablement.

title: How is Cree LED Performing Under New Ownership?
summary: Cree LED, acquired by Smart Global Holdings (SGH) in March 2021, has seen its sales decline for four consecutive quarters, with the most recent quarter dipping below $100 million for the first time under SGH ownership. While SGH aimed for growth and diversification with the acquisition, Cree LED's financial performance represents 22% of SGH's total revenues. The article suggests it might be too early to definitively judge Cree LED's performance due to long design-in sales cycles, but indicates that an upward trend in sales is necessary by mid-fiscal year 2023 for SGH to realize a favorable return on investment.

title: Walmart blazes trails with its enterprise ‘supercloud’
summary: Walmart has developed an enterprise "supercloud" called the Walmart Cloud Native Platform, which abstracts away differences between public cloud providers, its hybrid cloud, and edge computing nodes. This multicloud environment aims to optimize resource consumption, drive developer productivity, and enhance network resilience and data analysis. The company is also overhauling its legacy software infrastructure to containers, aiming for portability and resiliency over pure cost savings, and has been able to make 170,000 website adjustments monthly.

title: Logitech Sight AI Camera Makes Hybrid Work Meetings More Equitable for Remote Participants
summary: Logitech announced Logitech Sight, an AI-powered tabletop camera designed to make hybrid work meetings more equitable for remote participants. This multi-camera system works with Logitech's Rally Bar or Rally Bar Mini to provide remote workers with an "at the table" experience, effectively addressing the disparity between in-office and remote colleagues. Logitech Sight features dual 4K cameras and seven beamforming microphones, integrates with major video conferencing platforms, and is designed with sustainability in mind.

title: Equinix Expands to Indonesia with $74M Data Center Investment
summary: Equinix, Inc. is expanding its operations to Indonesia with a planned $74 million investment in an International Business Exchange (IBX) data center in Jakarta. This expansion aims to meet the growing digital needs of Indonesian businesses and multinational companies operating in the region, supporting the country's rapid digitalization and its emergence as Southeast Asia's largest digital economy. The new eight-story facility, set to open by the second half of 2024, will offer over 1,600 cabinets and more than 5,300 square meters of colocation space, strategically located in Jakarta's Central Business District.

title: Microsoft, Kyndryl deal connects Azure to IBM mainframe data
summary: Microsoft and Kyndryl have expanded their partnership to facilitate the transfer of mainframe data to Azure, enabling access to AI, web-based analytics, and machine learning capabilities. This collaboration aims to break mainframe data out of its silos by creating secure data pipes between IBM mainframes and Azure, leveraging Microsoft's Power Platform. The deal is seen as a strategic move benefiting both companies and allowing IBM to further its multi-cloud strategy while making mainframe data more accessible for modern application development.

title: ‘LofyGang’ hacking group targets Discord, Disney+ and Minecraft accounts
summary: Security researchers at Checkmarx Ltd. have exposed a hacking group named "LofyGang" responsible for over 200 malicious packages and thousands of installations in 2022. The group, believed to be Brazilian, targets online accounts to steal credit card information and premium accounts for services like Discord, Disney+, and Minecraft. LofyGang operates openly, promoting tools on GitHub and having a Discord server, highlighting the risks of untrusted open-source code.

title: Quantum Company Of The Week: IonQ
summary: IonQ is a leading quantum hardware manufacturer founded in 2015, specializing in trapped-ion technology to build powerful quantum computers. The company has launched two quantum computers, Harmony and Aria, and is set to release Forte in 2023, promising significant improvements in performance. IonQ has secured substantial funding, formed key partnerships with Microsoft and Hyundai, and became the first public pure-play quantum computing company listed on the NYSE in October 2021.

title: Game Pass generated nearly $3 billion in 2021, accounting for 30% of Microsoft’s gaming revenue
summary: Microsoft's Game Pass subscription service generated nearly $3 billion in console revenue in 2021, representing 18% of Microsoft's total annual gaming revenue and almost 30% of its games and services revenue. This data comes from a filing to the Brazilian regulator, CADE, days after it approved Microsoft's acquisition of Activision Blizzard. While PC earnings remain undisclosed, the service's performance compares to PlayStation's Network Services, which earned $3.64 billion in FY 2021.

title: 2022 Pinnacle Awards Finalists Unveiled
summary: WashingtonExec has announced the finalists for its 2022 Pinnacle Awards, recognizing mission-focused industry executives and government officials. The awards ceremony will be held on November 30 at The Ritz Carlton in Tysons Corner, Virginia, celebrating leaders across various categories including AI, cybersecurity, climate change, and cloud technology. The program aims to highlight successful executives and businesses driving innovation for federal clients.

title: Novo Nordisk 2022: Expanding capabilities
summary: Novo Nordisk rallied in 2021-2022 despite supply issues with its weight-loss drug Wegovy, showcasing strong financial performance driven by products like Ozempic. The company is diversifying its pipeline into areas like NASH and cardiovascular disease through strategic acquisitions and partnerships, while also advancing its diabetes treatment portfolio with innovations such as once-weekly insulin icodec. Novo Nordisk aims to strengthen its leadership in diabetes care and enhance R&D through collaborations in AI and oral drug delivery technologies.

title: 'Sense the Wonder': Sony Semiconductor Solutions at the heart of the new Sensing Society
summary: Terushi Shimizu, President & CEO of Sony Semiconductor Solutions (SSS) discusses the company's focus on image sensor technology, emphasizing its unique "monozukuri" philosophy through vertical integration and advanced manufacturing for analog devices like CMOS image sensors. The article highlights SSS's strategy of concentrating on image sensors to navigate market volatility, strategic partnerships like the one with TSMC for the JASM foundry, and the development of intelligent vision sensors with integrated AI, contributing to edge computing solutions for various applications such as smart cities and automotive safety. Shimizu also shares his vision for SSS to evolve beyond hardware into software and solutions, establishing "AITRIOS" as a key platform for implementing sensing solutions in society.

title: Top 6 challenges of a zero-trust security model
summary: The zero-trust security model offers significant advantages in cybersecurity but also presents several challenges that organizations must understand and overcome. These challenges include the risk of creating security gaps with a piecemeal approach, the absence of all-in-one zero-trust products, difficulties in adapting legacy systems, the need for continuous administration and maintenance, potential hindrance to productivity, and inherent security risks within the model itself. Overcoming these involves running trials, starting small, scaling slowly, and fostering a supportive workplace culture.

title: Walmart Finance standardizes on Power BI for reporting and analytics
summary: Walmart Finance has standardized on Microsoft Power BI for its reporting and analytics needs, aiming to centralize, democratize, and optimize its vast financial data. This move allows associates, from leadership to analysts, easy access to comprehensive data, enabling efficient analysis and reducing time spent on data gathering. The implementation leverages Power BI's semantic models, combined with in-memory and DirectQuery modes, and incremental refresh, to provide scalable, cost-effective, and actionable insights across the organization.

title: Forbes 50 over 50 features 7 Indian-American women
summary: Forbes' recent 50 Over 50 list highlights seven high-profile Indian American women who are making significant contributions across various fields, including technology, business, and social impact. These women, comprising entrepreneurs, CEOs, and activists, demonstrate that age is no barrier to achieving success and making a difference. The featured individuals showcase their achievements in leading major corporations, founding innovative companies, and advocating for social causes.

summary: This article recommends investing in the Invesco Nasdaq 100 ETF (QQQM) for a Roth IRA, especially given market turmoil. The author highlights why QQQM was chosen over the more common QQQ and discusses its appeal after significant price declines in quality tech stocks like Apple, Amazon, and Microsoft. The author also mentions a collaboration with Hoya Capital for an income-focused investing service.

title: Poly Delivers Extensive Portfolio of Devices Certified for Microsoft Teams to Achieve Greater Meeting Collaboration
summary: Poly has announced an expanded portfolio of Microsoft Teams certified solutions aimed at enhancing meeting equity and collaboration. These new and updated devices, ranging from video conferencing systems to phones, are designed for various meeting spaces and work styles, offering features like Poly DirectorAI technology for improved remote user experience and NoiseBlockAI for clearer audio. This initiative builds on Poly's long-standing partnership with Microsoft to provide comprehensive communication solutions for hybrid work environments.

title: Making sense of the shoebox: How H&R Block uses Azure AI to transform tax returns
summary: H&R Block is leveraging Microsoft Azure AI services, including Azure Form Recognizer and Azure Cognitive Search, to modernize its tax preparation process. This transformation allows tax professionals to spend less time on data entry and more time on personalized client interactions. By digitizing documents and streamlining client history retrieval, H&R Block aims to reduce client anxiety, enhance efficiency, and provide richer financial conversations, aligning with evolving client needs for digital and hybrid tax solutions.

title: Zeek is Now a Component of Microsoft Windows
summary: Corelight announced that Zeek, a popular open-source network security monitoring platform, has been integrated into Microsoft Windows and Defender for Endpoint. This integration aims to enhance security teams' ability to respond to advanced threats by providing richer signals for threat hunting, improved IoT device discovery, and more powerful detection and response capabilities. The move highlights Microsoft's commitment to supporting open-source projects and expands Zeek's impact on endpoint defense.

title: Mercedes-Benz and Microsoft collaborate to boost efficiency, resilience and sustainability in car production
summary: Mercedes-Benz and Microsoft are partnering to enhance the efficiency, resilience, and sustainability of car production through the new MO360 Data Platform. This platform will connect Mercedes-Benz's global passenger car plants to the Microsoft Cloud, enabling faster identification of supply chain bottlenecks, dynamic resource allocation for electric and Top-End Luxury vehicles, and data-driven decisions on the shop floor. The collaboration aims for a 20% improvement in passenger car production efficiency by 2025 and will help reduce the ecological footprint by monitoring and forecasting carbon emissions, energy, water usage, and waste management.

title: Microsoft debuts new Surface devices with chip and design upgrades
summary: Microsoft unveiled three new Surface devices: the Surface Pro 9, Surface Studio 2+, and Surface Pro 5 Laptop, all featuring updated processors and design enhancements. The Surface Pro 9, a two-in-one device, offers both Intel Alder Lake and Arm-based SQ3 chip options. The Surface Studio 2+ workstation was updated with an Intel Core i7-11370H chip and Nvidia RTX 3060 graphics, while the Surface Pro 5 Laptop is available in two screen sizes with Intel Alder Lake processors.

title: WEF recognises Dr. Reddy’s Hyd factory as part of its Global Lighthouse Network
summary: Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories' manufacturing facility in Bachupally, Hyderabad, has been recognized by the World Economic Forum (WEF) as part of its Global Lighthouse Network for leadership in applying Fourth Industrial Revolution technologies. This recognition highlights the factory's success in leveraging digital advancements to enhance productivity, workforce engagement, sustainability, and supply chain resilience. Cipla's Oral Solid Dosage plant in Indore also received similar recognition, showcasing the growing adoption of Industry 4.0 technologies in the Indian pharmaceutical sector.

title: Cisco partners with Microsoft to add Teams to its meeting devices
summary: Cisco Systems Inc. will integrate Microsoft Corp.'s Teams messaging app into its meeting devices, offering users an alternative to its Webex video conferencing software. Cisco aims to be a hardware platform for various conferencing software, including Microsoft Teams, Zoom, and Google, believing this strategy will enhance customer experience and benefit the company. This move comes as Webex faces stiff competition from newer platforms like Zoom.

title: Cisco partners with Microsoft to add Teams to its meeting devices
summary: Cisco Systems Inc. announced a partnership with Microsoft Corp. to integrate the Teams messaging app into its meeting devices. This move offers an alternative to Cisco's Webex and allows users to access various conferencing platforms on Cisco hardware, reflecting a strategy to become a versatile hardware platform for multiple software providers. Microsoft Teams will be available on Cisco devices starting in the first quarter of next year.

title: Microsoft uses strategically located subsidiaries to lower taxes more than previously known, new analysis finds
summary: A new report by the Centre for International Corporate Tax Accountability and Research (CICTAR) alleges that Microsoft uses a network of subsidiaries, particularly in Ireland and Bermuda, to significantly minimize its tax liabilities globally. While not suggesting illegal activity, the analysis raises concerns about profit shifting and its impact on tax revenues in countries where Microsoft conducts substantial business. The report points out that despite high profit margins, some Microsoft subsidiaries report much lower margins, reducing taxable income.

title: |‘Short-form video has changed the way music is performed, shared, and enjoyed. Competition for eyeballs is fierce.’
summary: |The article features an interview with Sherry Tan, Managing Director of Warner Music China, discussing the rapid growth of China's music market, now the world's sixth-largest. Tan highlights the significant impact of short-form video platforms like Douyin on music consumption and promotion, as well as Warner Music China's strategy to localize and foster international careers for Chinese artists. She also addresses opportunities in gaming, Web3, and the challenges of fierce competition for audience attention in a constantly evolving digital landscape.

title: Haleon to improve accessibility for visually impaired customers
summary: Haleon has partnered with Microsoft to enhance accessibility for blind and partially sighted customers using the Seeing AI app. The app allows users to scan barcodes of over 1,500 Haleon products, including Sensodyne and Centrum, to hear information like product names, ingredients, and instructions. This initiative aims to promote health inclusivity and greater independence for visually impaired individuals, with plans for global expansion and Android availability.

title: Microsoft - Gaming Global Taxes, Winning Government Contracts
summary: A new report by CICTAR alleges that Microsoft uses a complex network of shell companies in various tax havens, such as Bermuda, to significantly reduce its global tax obligations while simultaneously securing lucrative government contracts. The report highlights instances where Microsoft subsidiaries, despite reporting billions in profits, pay little to no tax, leading to public funds being diverted from essential services like healthcare and education. Public Services International calls for transparency in corporate taxation and suggests that governments should mandate global tax standards for companies seeking public contracts.

title: N-able’s Cove Data Protection aims to compete with Veeam, Datto and Commvault Metallic
summary: N-able is rebranding its backup solution to Cove Data Protection, positioning it as a core offering to directly compete with major players like Veeam, Datto, Acronis, and Commvault Metallic. The multi-tenant cloud solution (SaaS) focuses on efficient file-level backups for endpoints and Microsoft 365, stored across N-able's global data centers, with an emphasis on competitive pricing for MSPs. While currently prioritizing Microsoft 365 support, N-able aims to differentiate itself through efficiency and cost-effectiveness, bringing enterprise-level technology to SMEs via MSPs.

title: How much Netflix’s new ad-supported plan will cost and what you get (and don’t)
summary: Netflix is launching a cheaper, ad-supported plan for $6.99 a month starting November 3rd in the U.S., which will include 4 to 5 minutes of commercials per hour. While this plan offers a discount, some shows and movies will be unavailable due to licensing, and downloads won't be permitted. This move comes as Netflix faces increased competition and investor pressure to grow its subscriber base and revenue.

title: 5 Minutes with… Erica Roberts
summary: Erica Roberts, the newly appointed CCO at BBH USA, discusses her move from Publicis New York and her long-standing admiration for BBH's unique approach to advertising. She highlights the agency's distinct culture and leadership, emphasizing its "zag" mentality in a "zigging" industry. Roberts also touches on her previous impactful work for The J.M. Smucker Company and the "Power of One" model within Publicis Groupe.

title: LaLiga and Globant agree to create global technology company
summary: LaLiga has announced a joint venture with Globant, a software development company, to establish a global technology company focused on sports and entertainment. This partnership aims to advance LaLiga Tech's products and services, incorporating new technologies like Web 3.0, metaverse, and gaming, while expanding its global reach. Both parties anticipate this collaboration will enhance fan engagement and drive digital transformation in the sports industry.

title: 3M’s Post-It Partners With Microsoft on Brainstorming App Venture
summary: 3M's Post-It brand has partnered with Microsoft to launch a new app designed to digitize brainstorming. The app, available to Microsoft Teams users, provides a virtual whiteboard and sticky notes for collaborative idea sharing in hybrid environments. It allows users to upload photos of physical Post-Its, sort and organize ideas, and includes features like "Search & Stack" and "Zen Mode."

title: Microsoft Office suite becomes Microsoft 365 app
summary: Microsoft Corporation announced that its productivity suite, including Office.com, the Office mobile app, and the Office app for Windows, will merge into a single "Microsoft 365 app." This change, featuring a new icon and more features, will roll out gradually starting November 2022. Existing accounts, subscriptions, and files will be automatically updated without disruption, and users can continue to access core applications like Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

title: Seeing AI app launched by Haleon and Microsoft to enhance sight accessibility
summary: Haleon and Microsoft have collaborated to expand the functionality of the Microsoft Seeing AI app, making product labels more accessible for visually impaired individuals. This partnership will allow the app to provide detailed information on over 1500 Haleon products in the UK and US, enabling users to hear product names, ingredients, and usage instructions simply by scanning barcodes. The initiative aims to enhance independence for those with sight loss or low literacy.

title: Solving customer problems in real-time with at NetApp Cloud Field Day Exclusive
summary: This article discusses the second part of NetApp's Cloud Field Day Exclusive, focusing on real-world solutions for hybrid and multicloud challenges. It highlights how NetApp addresses customer pain points like skill gaps, complexity, cost optimization, and consistency in diverse cloud environments. The day also included a Q&A session with Google Cloud executives, discussing the partnership and the future of cloud file storage.

title: The female venture capitalist creating billions in a new world of work beyond the office
summary: Brianne Kimmel's Worklife Ventures has invested in 50 startups since 2019, with nine valued over $1 billion, focusing on the changing work/life balance and the future of remote work. Kimmel, whose venture is backed by Marc Andreessen and Zoom CEO Eric Yuan, plans to continue scaling businesses for freelancers and creators. Despite economic challenges, Worklife Ventures aims to support companies enabling productive work outside traditional office settings, a thesis Kimmel developed before the pandemic.
