title: Microsoft Teams SIP Gateway to support analog phones via Analog...
summary: Microsoft announced at Ignite that its Teams SIP Gateway will support analog phones starting in early 2023, allowing existing analog endpoints like door access systems and elevator phones to connect to Teams. It will support specific Analog Telephone Adaptors (ATAs) from AudioCodes, Cisco, and Poly. Additionally, SIP Gateway will support Algo overhead paging devices, ringers, and speakers, also coming in 2023.

title: Mercedes-Benz strikes Dolby Atmos partnership with Apple Music and Universal
summary: Mercedes-Benz has partnered with Universal Music Group and Apple Music to integrate Spatial Audio with Dolby Atmos into its vehicles, making them the first non-Apple devices to offer this feature natively in a car. This collaboration aims to set a new standard for in-car music quality, with UMG encouraging artists to mix music in Dolby Atmos and using Mercedes-Benz vehicles for song approval and quality assurance. Drivers with Apple Music subscriptions can now access Spatial Audio content in compatible Mercedes-Benz models.

title: Microsoft to drive sustainability through the Microsoft Cloud
summary: Microsoft is expanding its Cloud for Sustainability platform with new ESG capabilities to help organizations track and reduce their environmental footprint. The updates include enhanced calculation methodologies for Scope 3 emissions, improved usability and security features in Microsoft Sustainability Manager, and an expanded data model for water and carbon data. Additionally, Microsoft has updated the Emissions Impact Dashboard for Azure and introduced Environmental Credit Service to streamline the voluntary environmental markets.

title: Exploring the Metaverse
summary: Nigel Pereira explores the metaverse, describing it as a three-dimensional internet populated with live people, tracing its origins to Neal Stephenson's 1992 novel "Snow Crash." The article discusses the current state of disconnected metaverses, similar to the early internet, and highlights real-world applications in simulation for surgery, science, and training, as well as virtual tourism and collaboration with NASA.

title: Gartner Top 10 Strategic Technology Trends for 2023
summary: Gartner has identified the Top 10 Strategic Technology Trends for 2023, which are categorized into four key priorities: Optimize, Scale, Pioneer, and Sustainable Technology. These trends aim to help organizations enhance resilience, improve productivity, engage customers, and pursue sustainable solutions. The article details each of the ten trends and their potential impact on business strategies over the next three years.

title: Morgan Stanley CEO James Gorman: “I'm perfectly happy to see our tech spend go up”
summary: Morgan Stanley CEO James Gorman expressed satisfaction with increased tech spending, viewing it as crucial for efficiency and innovation, despite a 22% drop in bank revenues. He highlighted the importance of cloud technology, robo-advisors, and cybersecurity, while also reflecting on market recalibrations due to past "ridiculous" valuations and the return to fundamental economic principles. The bank's wealth management and fixed income sectors performed well, offsetting a decline in investment banking.

title: What’s Changed: 2022 Magic Quadrant for Security Information and Event Management
summary: This article analyzes Gartner's 2022 Magic Quadrant for Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), highlighting significant changes since the 2021 report. It details vendor movements within the Leaders, Challengers, and Visionaries quadrants, noting company-specific developments and new entrants. The report focuses on shifts including Microsoft's rise, IBM's stability, and the repositioning of several other key SIEM providers.

title: Announcing the 2022 CyberScoop 50 award winners
summary: Scoop News Group has announced the winners of the 2022 CyberScoop 50 Awards, celebrating cybersecurity leaders in both public and private sectors. These individuals are recognized for their work in protecting vital networks, information, and critical infrastructure through hard work, ingenuity, and creativity. The awards highlight a diverse group from the information security community, ranging from newcomers to seasoned policy and strategy officials.

title: Gartner Top 10 Tech Trends For 2023: Metaverse, AI, Cloud
summary: Gartner has released its top 10 technology trends for 2023, focusing on themes like optimizing resilience, scaling solutions, and pioneering new opportunities amidst economic uncertainty. The trends include the metaverse, super apps, adaptive AI, industry cloud platforms, and sustainability, emphasizing technology's role in addressing global challenges and driving business value beyond just cost savings. Each trend is accompanied by an example of its real-world application.

title: Cybersecurity spending on pace to surpass $260B by 2026
summary: Global cybersecurity spending on information security and risk management products and services is projected to reach $262 billion by 2026, growing at an 11% compound annual growth rate from 2021. This growth is primarily driven by the increase in remote work, the shift to zero trust network access, and the adoption of cloud-based delivery models. Cloud security and application security are identified as the strongest growth categories, with security services making up over 40% of the projected spending in 2023.

title: M&A List: Identity and Access Management (IAM) Security Mergers and Acquisitions -
summary: This article compiles a list of mergers and acquisitions in the Identity and Access Management (IAM) security market, highlighting the robust M&A activity driven by market fragmentation and strong demand from MSSPs, MSPs, and end-customers. The global IAM market is projected to reach $34.52 billion by 2028, growing at a 14.5% CAGR from 2021. The list details specific acquisitions and mergers from 2017 to 2022 involving key players and private equity firms in the cybersecurity space.

title: Zillow Sued For Alleged Wiretapping
summary: Zillow is facing multiple class-action lawsuits in Pennsylvania, Washington, and Missouri, alleging violations of state wiretapping laws. These lawsuits, similar to prior cases against Facebook and Carrier IQ, claim that Zillow and its third-party vendors (like Microsoft) record users' mouse movements, clicks, keystrokes, and other interactions to create "session replays" without explicit consent. The article highlights the ongoing debate about consumer privacy versus the need for website analytics, and the implications of applying older wiretapping laws to modern web technologies.

title: ING uses Microsoft Security solutions to reimagine banking for a digital audience
summary: ING, one of Europe's top banks, has adopted Microsoft Security solutions to unify its fragmented IT landscape and enhance its security posture. This move addresses the challenge of coordinating global IT departments and managing a diverse technical environment, ultimately improving efficiency for security teams and providing greater visibility across its digital assets. The bank now leverages Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft 365 Defender, and other Microsoft solutions to proactively defend against cyberthreats and navigate a complex regulatory environment.

title: Turtle Beach Expands Its Mobile Gaming Accessories Line With the Debut of the Brand’s Hyper-Portable Atom Controller
summary: Turtle Beach has announced the launch of its new Atom Controller, an hyper-portable mobile gaming accessory designed for Android 8.0+ smartphones. The controller features a unique two-piece design that connects magnetically, offering console-style controls and low-latency Bluetooth connectivity for cloud gaming. Available for pre-order at $99.99 MSRP and launching on November 14, 2022, the Atom Controller aims to provide a high-quality mobile gaming experience.

title: Amazon Helps Ukrainians Gain New Skills and Launch Tech Careers
summary: Amazon Web Services (AWS) launched "IT Skills 4U," a free workforce-development program aimed at helping Ukrainians pursue careers in cloud computing. The program, available virtually and in Poland, addresses the challenges faced by over 7.5 million Ukrainians who have fled their homes. More than 30 AWS customers and partners, including EPAM Systems, have committed to offering jobs, internships, and traineeships to program participants.

title: The 5x Spike & Now Implosion of Generac’s Stock Shows What Went Horribly Wrong in the Markets since Feb. 2020
summary: This article by Wolf Richter on Wolf Street examines the implosion of Generac Holdings (GNRC) stock, which surged five-fold from February 2020 to November 2021 before dropping 79% from its peak. Richter uses Generac as a case study to demonstrate the "stock-market craziness" fueled by factors like ZIRP and QE policies, and the subsequent brutal unwinding of these inflated valuations. The piece also criticizes Wall Street analysts for maintaining "buy" ratings even after significant stock drops, and discusses the broader implications for dip-buyers and the market as a whole.

title: Nubank Becomes the Latest Latin American Company to Launch a Cryptocurrency
summary: Brazilian fintech Nubank, backed by Warren Buffett, has announced the launch of its own digital currency, Nucoin, on the Polygon blockchain network. Scheduled for release in the first half of 2023, Nucoin will be distributed to customers for free and will form the basis of a benefits program in Brazil. This move follows MercadoLibre's launch of Mercado Coin and highlights a growing trend among Latin American companies to integrate cryptocurrencies into loyalty programs, despite the ongoing "crypto winter."

title: Oracle Cloud adds NVIDIA chips, software to speed enterprise AI uptake
summary: Oracle has expanded its partnership with NVIDIA to integrate tens of thousands of NVIDIA's AI-processing graphics chips and software tools into Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). This aims to accelerate enterprise AI adoption across industries like banking, healthcare, and manufacturing by offering powerful A100 and upcoming H100 GPUs. The collaboration will also provide access to NVIDIA software like RAPIDS Accelerator and Clara for enhanced AI performance, medical imaging, and drug discovery.

title: Check Point Research analyzes the newly emerged Black Basta Ransomware, alerts organizations to adopt prevention best practices
summary: Check Point Research (CPR) has analyzed the Black Basta ransomware, detailing its delivery methods, evasions, and anti-analysis techniques. The group has hit over 89 organizations since May 2022, with a focus on the US and Germany, and demands millions in ransom. CPR urges organizations to implement robust data backups, keep software updated, scan emails and file activity, use anti-ransomware solutions, and provide cyber awareness training to prevent attacks.

title: WithSecure adds Microsoft OneDrive protection to its cloud-based security platform
summary: WithSecure Corp. has expanded its cloud-based security platform, WithSecure Elements, by integrating Microsoft OneDrive for Business protection. This new feature enhances collaboration protection by continuously scanning and analyzing files uploaded or modified in OneDrive, leveraging real-time threat intelligence and isolated cloud sandboxing to detect and block malicious content. The move addresses the growing security concerns around cloud-based collaboration tools, which are becoming essential for many companies, especially with the shift to remote work.

title: Krispy Kreme: The doughnut company continues its revival
summary: Krispy Kreme is partnering with McDonald's to test selling its doughnuts in nine Kentucky locations, signaling a continued revival for the company. After facing challenges post-IPO, including accusations of "channel stuffing," Krispy Kreme was taken private in 2016 and adopted a "hub and spoke" model to ensure product freshness. This strategy has proven successful, with sales projected to reach $1.5 billion this year, tripling 2015 figures.

title: Battle with Bots Prompts Mass Purge of Amazon, Apple Employee Accounts on LinkedIn
summary: LinkedIn experienced a significant purge of fake employee accounts for companies like Amazon and Apple, with some firms seeing a 33% to 50% drop in listed employees overnight. The purges are believed to be LinkedIn's attempt to combat the proliferation of AI-generated profiles and fraudulent activity, including "pig butchering" scams and identity theft. This event highlights a larger problem of bot accounts and raises questions about the accuracy of LinkedIn's employee statistics and its broader impact on the platform's reliability for hiring and networking.

title: Salesforce Inc. stock outperforms market on strong trading day
summary: Salesforce Inc. (CRM) stock rallied 2.49% to $157.50 on a strong trading day, outperforming the broader market which saw the S&P 500 and Dow Jones Industrial Average decline. This marked the stock's fourth consecutive day of gains, though it remained significantly below its 52-week high. Salesforce also outperformed several key competitors including Microsoft Corp. and SAP SE ADR.

title: Report: Oracle slows hiring, especially in Bay Area and Seattle, raising fears of deeper cuts
summary: Oracle has reportedly slowed its hiring efforts, particularly in the Bay Area and Seattle, leading to concerns about potential deeper job cuts. Hiring managers have been instructed to delay start dates for new recruits as the company significantly scales back its recruitment activities. This move by Oracle follows similar actions by other tech giants like Microsoft and Google, signaling a potential shift in the tech job market.

title: Enhancing your world with Augmented Reality
summary: This article explores the concept and vast applications of Augmented Reality (AR), distinguishing it from Virtual Reality (VR). It highlights how AR overlays digital information onto the real world, transforming industries from entertainment and retail to healthcare and agriculture. The author emphasizes AR's potential to provide real-time information and enhance human perception, making everyday tasks and specialized fields more interactive and efficient.

title: InterDigital and Inria Launch Joint Lab in Metaverse Tech
summary: InterDigital and Inria have established a joint laboratory named NEMO.AI in Brittany to develop cutting-edge technologies for the metaverse era. The collaboration builds on a long-standing relationship and aims to address the need for a common standard in metaverse avatars and objects, with a focus on AI-based solutions and contributions to the MPEG consortium. The initiative is supported by the French government's post-Covid economic recovery plan.

title: 7 Virtual Reality Stocks to Buy to Bet on the Coming VR Boom
summary: The virtual reality market is projected to grow significantly to over $227 billion by 2029, presenting a massive opportunity for investors, especially as many top VR stocks are currently oversold. This article highlights seven virtual reality stocks to consider, including the ProShares Metaverse ETF (VERS) for diversification, Roblox (RBLX) as a leading social metaverse platform, and tech giants like Microsoft (MSFT) and Apple (AAPL) that are heavily investing in VR/AR. Other recommendations include Nvidia (NVDA) for its Omniverse platform, Matterport (MTTR) for its exposure to "digital twins," and Unity Software (U) which recently received a "buy" rating.

title: Microsoft Corp Acquires 25-Acre Land in Pimpri-Waghere for Data Centre
summary: Microsoft Corp. has acquired a 25-acre commercial plot in Pimpri-Waghere, Pune, for approximately Rs 329 crore to establish a hyperscale data center. This acquisition from Finolex Industries is part of Microsoft's broader multi-city data center strategy for India, with the potential to develop a 100 MW cloud capacity data center. The company also has ongoing data center projects in Hyderabad, in collaboration with the Telangana government.

title: 2020s–Today
summary: The article details SLB's (formerly Schlumberger) strategic evolution from the 2020s to today, focusing on its commitment to decarbonization and a balanced planet. It outlines the company's shift towards new energy ventures like geothermal, clean hydrogen, and lithium while continuing to innovate in oil and gas with digital solutions and emissions reduction technologies. Key events include brand changes, major collaborations, and advancements in AI, energy storage, and sustainability, emphasizing SLB's net-zero emissions goal by 2050 and its push for diversity.

title: How self-healing endpoints are a solution to identities under siege
summary: Cyberattackers frequently target endpoints to steal identity data and compromise networks, with malware-free intrusions being particularly hard to detect. The growing threat has led to increased spending on endpoint security and the adoption of self-healing endpoints as a critical part of Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) frameworks. These systems, utilizing AI and firmware-based solutions, aim to proactively secure devices, reduce manual IT tasks, and improve overall resilience against identity-based attacks.

title: Transatlantic Rubrik partner Assured Data Protection is added to Arrow Electronics' cloud platform
summary: Arrow Electronics has added Assured Data Protection (ADP), a global MSP specializing in data protection built on Rubrik technology, to its ArrowSphere cloud platform. This partnership aims to provide channel partners with enhanced data backup, business continuity, disaster recovery, and threat detection solutions, particularly in response to the increasing threat of ransomware. ADP's services will be available through various purchasing models, strengthening Arrow's security portfolio and expanding ADP's reach within the Arrow ecosystem.

title: Here Are Cisco’s Most Highly Compensated Executives In 2022
summary: Cisco's 2022 proxy filing revealed the top-compensated executives, highlighting their contributions to the company's business model transformation, particularly its shift towards subscription-based services and Everything-as-a-Service offerings. The list includes CEO Chuck Robbins, CFO Scott Herren, and newly added executives like Chief Legal Officer Dev Stahlkopf and Chief Customer and Partner Officer Jeff Sharritts, alongside veterans like Maria Martinez and Gerri Elliott. The compensation packages, detailed from lowest to highest, reflect a mix of salaries, stock awards, and incentive plans, with notable bonuses for new hires.

title: Walmart sets the stage for crypto payments
summary: Walmart is moving towards adopting cryptocurrencies as a payment option for its customers and plans to create NFTs in the metaverse, according to its Global Chief of Technology. This move could significantly bridge the gap between cryptocurrencies and mainstream consumers. The article also touches on other crypto news, including institutional adoption by Fidelity, legal issues with NFT project Slotie, Solana's continued blockchain outages, new crypto regulations in the UK, and Kraken's compliance with EU sanctions against Russia.

title: UN’s Coke sponsorship leaves bad taste with environmentally conscious groups
summary: Coca-Cola's sponsorship of the COP27 U.N. climate summit has sparked outrage among environmental groups and activists, who accuse the company of "greenwash" due to its significant contribution to plastic pollution. Critics argue that corporate involvement, especially from major polluters, undermines the integrity of climate negotiations and provides a marketing platform rather than genuine commitment to environmental solutions. The controversy highlights broader concerns about corporate lobbying and influence at critical international climate conferences.

title: Taskbar Not Working? Here's How to Fix It
summary: This article provides various solutions for common Windows 10 taskbar issues, such as freezing, disappearing, or not responding. It covers fixes ranging from decluttering the taskbar and restarting the explorer process to updating Windows and using PowerShell commands. The guide also offers advice for more persistent problems like creating a new user account or performing a system restore.

title: Wells Fargo taps Google AI on virtual assistant launch
summary: Wells Fargo announced its collaboration with Google Cloud to power its new virtual assistant, Fargo, which will assist customers with tasks like managing debit cards, checking credit limits, and searching transactions. This move is part of Wells Fargo's broader digital transformation strategy. Fargo will use Google's conversational AI platform, Dialogflow, and will eventually offer predictive analytics and support Spanish speakers, aiming to enhance customers' financial well-being.

title: Are Your Mobile and IoT Devices Weakening Your Security?
summary: This article discusses the security risks posed by the increasing number of connected mobile and IoT devices, highlighting common vulnerabilities such as weak passwords, unsecured network services, lack of physical hardening, insecure data transfer, and poor device management. It emphasizes the need for organizations to implement strong security strategies, including robust passwords, two-factor authentication, regular updates, and secure device management software, to protect against data breaches and cyberattacks. The article also suggests outsourcing detection and response operations as a viable security measure.

title: Equifax's Lessons Are Still Relevant, 5 Years Later
summary: Five years after the extensive Equifax data breach, cybersecurity professionals emphasize that the lessons learned remain crucial for enterprises. The breach, which exposed the personal data of millions due to an unpatched Apache Struts vulnerability, highlights critical issues in data management, the importance of fundamental cybersecurity practices, and the need for proactive cyber resilience. Experts advise organizations to improve data classification, implement zero-trust architectures, and invest in skilled security teams to prevent similar incidents.

title: Coke Sponsoring COP27 Is the Definition of ‘Greenwashing,’ Activists Say
summary: Activists are criticizing the United Nations' decision to accept Coca-Cola as a sponsor for COP27, labeling the partnership as "pure greenwash." They point to Coca-Cola's significant contribution to global plastic waste and its historical lobbying against environmental regulations, despite the company's claims of working towards emission reductions and plastic cleanup. Environmental groups argue that corporations deeply implicated in climate issues should not be allowed to sponsor critical climate summits.

title: Earnings Infographic: Microsoft (MSFT) Q1 revenue up 11%; earnings beat
summary: Microsoft (MSFT) reported stronger-than-expected earnings and revenues for the first quarter of fiscal year 2023, with revenues increasing 11% to $50.12 billion. Despite a drop in net profit to $17.56 billion or $2.35 per share, the results surpassed market projections. CEO Satya Nadella highlighted digital technology as a "tailwind" in challenging times, focusing on efficiency for customers and disciplined cost management.

title: Sony Electronics Announces the New LinkBuds S "Earth Blue" Noise Canceling Truly Wireless Headphones, Made from Water Dispenser Bottles¹ and New Model "LinkBuds UC for Microsoft Teams"
summary: Sony Electronics has announced new LinkBuds S "Earth Blue" noise-canceling truly wireless headphones, made from recycled water bottle materials, and a new "LinkBuds UC for Microsoft Teams" model. The "Earth Blue" LinkBuds S support Sony's "Road to Zero" environmental plan and will lead to a $500,000 donation to Conservation International. Additionally, a software update will bring multi-point connection to the LinkBuds series and WF-1000XM4 headphones, while the LinkBuds UC for Microsoft Teams offers enhanced features for online meetings.

title: Sam’s Club finishes chainwide deployment of inventory-scanning robots
summary: Sam's Club has completed the chainwide deployment of Inventory Scan automated robots across its nearly 600 stores. These robots, originally used for floor scrubbing, have been upgraded to also collect product availability, pricing data, planogram compliance, and stock levels. This initiative aligns with parent company Walmart's broader push into automation and AI technology to improve efficiency and free up associates for member engagement.

title: Wix Becomes An Official React Native Partner
summary: Wix.com Ltd. has announced its new status as an official partner of React Native (RN), an open-source UI software framework. This partnership signifies Wix's increased commitment to promoting open-source programming and advancing the RN framework by contributing its expertise and extensive RN codebase. Wix joins other major tech companies like Meta and Microsoft in shaping the future of React Native, which is used to build cross-platform mobile applications.

title: [New York Stock Market] Big Tech Earnings Awaited, Rising Around 1%... Chinese Companies Plunge
summary: Major New York stock indices closed higher as investors awaited earnings reports from big tech companies. However, Chinese stocks listed on the NYSE plunged significantly due to heightened regulatory concerns following Xi Jinping's confirmation for a third term. Economic indicators were mixed, and concerns about inflation and the Fed's interest rate hikes continue to influence the market, while Treasury yields saw a slight increase.

title: About J.B. Hunt Transport, Inc.
summary: J.B. Hunt Transport, a Fortune 500 company, leveraged IBM Turbonomic to optimize its cloud infrastructure across Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud. The solution enabled significant time savings and provided full-stack visibility and AI-powered recommendations, leading to a safe migration of a substantial compute environment from Azure to Google Cloud in only 35 business days with zero downtime. This ongoing partnership helps J.B. Hunt assure application performance and reduce waste in their hybrid cloud environment.

title: Valence Security raises new cash to secure the SaaS app supply chain
summary: Valence Security has raised $25 million in a Series A round, bringing its total funding to $32 million, to enhance its SaaS app supply chain security platform. The company aims to address the growing risks associated with interconnected SaaS applications, including misconfigurations and data breaches. The new capital will be used for product development and to double its 25-person team.

title: Bristol Myers Squibb CEO: We are on track to continue delivering growth
summary: Bristol Myers Squibb CEO Dr. Giovanni Caforio discussed the company's third-quarter earnings report on CNBC's 'Squawk on the Street'. He affirmed the company is on track to continue delivering growth. The interview provided insights into the company's financial performance and future outlook.

title: Corsair K100 Air review: Skinny keyboard, fat price tag
summary: The Corsair K100 Air is a super-thin mechanical keyboard featuring Cherry's Ultra-Low Profile switches, offering a sleek design and satisfying keyfeel with short travel. While praised for its aesthetics, engineering, and feature set including wireless connectivity and RGB lighting, its high price of $279.99 and short battery life with RGB on are significant drawbacks. The reviewer concludes that while it showcases impressive tech, it's too niche and expensive for most gamers and everyday users, suggesting the switches are better suited for gaming laptops.

title: OpenAI partners with Shutterstock to start selling AI-generated images soon
summary: Shutterstock is partnering with OpenAI to integrate DALL-E's AI image generation capabilities into its platform, allowing customers to generate images from textual prompts. This collaboration aims to provide new creative tools and revenue streams for artists by compensating them for content used to train the AI models. The move comes amidst a heated debate about AI-generated images, with other companies like Getty Images banning such content.

title: iShares S&P 100 ETF OEF
summary: This article provides current pricing and key metrics for the iShares S&P 100 ETF (OEF), highlighting its stability and offering guidance on how to invest through eToro. It details that OEF aims to replicate the S&P 100, comprising 100 top US companies like Apple and Microsoft. The piece also includes a section on trending ETFs and educational resources for investors.

title: Amazon predicts sales growth slowdown for holidays, crushing shares
summary: Amazon anticipates a significant slowdown in sales growth for the upcoming holiday season, prompting investor concern and an approximately $140 billion drop in its market capitalization. The company attributes this outlook to inflation-wary consumers and businesses tightening their spending, leading to lower-than-expected third-quarter net sales and a cautious approach to future growth. This mirrors a broader trend in the retail and tech sectors, with cloud-computing rivals also facing challenges amidst slowing economic conditions.

title: Office Corporate Vice President Joe Belfiore to leave Microsoft after 32 years
summary: Joe Belfiore, Corporate Vice President of Microsoft's Office Group, is retiring after a 32-year career with the company. His departure, effective next summer after a transition period, is a personal decision to spend more time with family. His responsibilities for the Office product line will be transitioned to Ales Holecek and Sumit Chauhan, with David Gainer promoted to Office "Head of Product."

title: Shares of ServiceNow Surge On Solid Q3 Beat
summary: ServiceNow (NYSE:NOW) shares surged by almost 13% in pre-market trading after the company reported a solid beat for its Q3 earnings. The software developer's adjusted EPS was $1.96 on revenue of $1.93 billion, exceeding analyst expectations. However, the company's subscription revenue forecast for Q4 and the full year came in below consensus estimates, despite the strong Q3 performance.

title: Manolis Kotzabasakis Named CEO at CentralSquare Technologies
summary: Manolis Kotzabasakis has been appointed as the new CEO of CentralSquare Technologies, effective November 5, 2022. He brings extensive experience from previous leadership roles at Trimble Inc. and Viewpoint Construction Software, where he focused on driving growth and digital transformation in vertical software. Kotzabasakis will succeed David Zolet, who led the company through the pandemic and positioned it as a leading SaaS player in government technology.

title: Microsoft and Sony in corporate battle over Call of Duty access
summary: Microsoft's pending $69 billion acquisition of Activision Blizzard has ignited a corporate battle with Sony over the future of the popular Call of Duty franchise. Sony fears losing access to the "must-have" title on its PlayStation platform if Microsoft makes it exclusive to Xbox or GamePass. Regulators in the U.S., UK, and EU are scrutinizing the deal amid Sony's concerns, while Microsoft assures Call of Duty will remain on PlayStation for at least "several more years."

title: Chart of the Week: Advisors Shifting Focus on Dividend ETFs
summary: Demand for dividend ETFs was high in 2022 due to rising interest rates,, but advisor focus might be shifting from high-yielding funds to those emphasizing capital appreciation and total return, particularly index-based dividend growth ETFs or actively managed dividend ETFs. This shift is influenced by rising 10-year Treasury yields exceeding 4.0% and advisors prioritizing capital appreciation over pure income.

title: Predictions 2023: AI Will Become An Indispensable, Trusted Enterprise Coworker
summary: In 2023, AI technology is predicted to become an indispensable and trusted enterprise coworker, transforming global markets. Key predictions include TuringBots writing 10% of worldwide code, one in four tech executives reporting to their board on AI governance, and 10% of Fortune 500 enterprises generating content with AI tools. These advancements signify AI's foundational role in successful enterprises and continued investment.

title: 2022 Diversity & Inclusion Report: Driving progress through greater accountability and transparency
summary: Microsoft released its 2022 Global Diversity & Inclusion Report, highlighting significant progress in workforce diversity and representation across various employee communities. The report emphasizes increased transparency with new data points on multiracial employees, military experience, workforce exits, and additional pay analysis. Microsoft reaffirms its commitment to pay equity and its Racial Equity Initiative goals, while also focusing on fostering an inclusive culture.

title: Chris Gondran of Home Bank - How to Protect Yourself and Your Assets from Cybersecurity Thieves
summary: Chris Gondran, Senior Vice President at Home Bank, offers critical advice on protecting digital assets from cybercriminals, emphasizing strong password practices, vigilance against social engineering scams (phishing, vishing, smishing), and the importance of multi-factor authentication and data backups. The article highlights how human error is a major cause of breaches and directs readers to resources like ic3.gov, stopthinkconnect.org, cisa.gov, and haveibeenpwned.com for further protection and reporting.

title: Oracle recognized as a Visionary in 2022 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Cloud Infrastructure and Platform Services
summary: Oracle has been recognized as a Visionary in the 2022 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Cloud Infrastructure and Platform Services (CIPS) and scored 3.59/5 in the Gartner 2022 Critical Capabilities for CIPS. The company highlights its strategic efforts in expanding cloud options, including distributed cloud offerings like Oracle Alloy, rapid global expansion of OCI regions, and enhanced multicloud capabilities through partnerships with Microsoft Azure. Oracle also emphasizes advancements in analytics, machine learning, AI, application development services, and comprehensive security features to provide more value and flexibility to its customers.

title: The only way is out - why ServiceNow’s RiseUp may be the solution the industry has been waiting for
summary: The article discusses the escalating tech talent shortage, highlighting the significant need for skilled workers in the evolving digital landscape. It presents ServiceNow's RiseUp program as a crucial solution, aiming to upskill one million individuals by 2024 by offering free courses, certification paths, and networking opportunities. The program emphasizes the importance of diverse hiring and collaborative efforts to address the global talent gap.

title: Burger King teams with Call of Duty for expansive international promo
summary: Burger King is launching its largest video-game partnership to date, collaborating with Call of Duty for the Modern Warfare II release across 39 global markets. The promotion, created with agency David New York, includes in-game rewards such as a Burger Town-themed Operator Skin and Double XP play time, available through the purchase of a Call of Duty Whopper Meal. Additionally, select Burger King stores will offer themed experiences, including playable Modern Warfare II kiosks in Paris and night-vision goggle experiences in South Africa, building on the strong connection between QSRs and gamers.

title: How SMBC Group became a leader in transformation and digital perseverance
summary: SMBC Group, one of Japan's largest banks, is undergoing a significant digital transformation by partnering with Microsoft as its strategic cloud provider. This collaboration aims to modernize IT infrastructure, develop innovative products like Embedded Finance and digital supply chain solutions, and support customers in achieving their sustainability goals. The article highlights how SMBC's approach to digital transformation also involves a cultural shift, emphasizing talent empowerment and a customer-first mindset, positioning them for "digital perseverance" in a changing industry.

title: Microsoft named a Leader in 2022 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Cloud Infrastructure and Platform Services
summary: Microsoft has been recognized as a Leader in the 2022 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Cloud Infrastructure and Platform Services for the ninth consecutive year, also placing furthest on the Completeness of Vision axis for the first time. The article highlights Microsoft's commitment to hybrid and multicloud solutions, continuous innovation in Azure services like Azure Arc and Microsoft Dev Box, and investments in mission-critical workloads and global datacenter expansion. It emphasizes Microsoft's dedication to helping customers optimize cloud investments and achieve their business goals amidst economic uncertainties.

title: Shopify acquires Remix to bolster its storefront design tools
summary: Shopify has acquired Remix, an open-source web framework similar to Next.js, to enhance its storefront design tools. The acquisition will provide Remix with long-term backing from Shopify, allowing it to accelerate growth and improve performance and scalability, with Shopify itself planning to integrate Remix across many projects. This move is expected to benefit developers building on Shopify's Hydrogen framework by addressing challenges in data loading, routing, and error handling.

title: Industry Voice: As Market Dynamics Pivot, Alpha Opportunities Are Set to Improve
summary: The US equity market has seen challenges for active managers due to low volatility, market concentration, and reliance on macro factors and momentum. Historically, however, such extreme market characteristics have often led to improved opportunities for active stock picking and outperformance against passive strategies as these conditions normalize. The article suggests that current market dynamics indicate a potential shift where active management could find more avenues for generating alpha.

title: Johnson Controls Honors Intaleq with OpenBlue Pioneers Award for First of Its Kind Stadium Technology at World Cup Qatar 2022
summary: Johnson Controls has awarded Intaleq with the OpenBlue Pioneers Award for creating a revolutionary connected digital command center for the World Cup Qatar 2022. This solution, powered by Johnson Controls OpenBlue and Microsoft Azure, transforms eight World Cup stadiums into one connected digital space, enabling real-time situational awareness and incident management. The technology utilizes "3D digital twins" for each stadium, providing live data on safety, comfort, and sustainability to significantly enhance security and operational efficiency during the event.

title: Jack Henry debuts P2P payments tool
summary: Jack Henry & Associates has launched a new standalone peer-to-peer (P2P) payments service for its community and regional bank clients, building on its recent acquisition of Payrailz. This tool offers an alternative or complement to existing services like Zelle, allowing customers to make or split payments using phone numbers or email addresses, and is part of Jack Henry's broader strategy to expand technological capabilities and acquire new companies. The company aims to meet the strong and growing demand for instant payments, despite facing headwinds from a lack of bank mergers impacting its profit margins and increased scrutiny from regulators like the CFPB regarding concentration of power among core service payment providers.

title: ESG Indexes Lifted by Carbon-Efficient Firms but Underperformed
summary: MSCI ACWI ESG Indexes underperformed during the first three quarters of 2022 despite generally outperforming from 2013-2021. While carbon-efficient firms positively contributed to performance, exclusions from the MSCI ACWI ESG Leaders Index due to ESG controversies and significant negative contributions from specific stocks like Apple and Amazon primarily drove the underperformance. Industry factors, particularly energy and aerospace and defense, saw a reversal in performance but played a lesser role in the overall ESG index underperformance compared to stock-specific exclusions and dollar strengthening.

title: OpenSSL vulnerability CVE-2022-3602 (Remote Code Execution) and CVE-2022-3786 (Denial of Service) Check Point Research Update
summary: Check Point Research released an update regarding two high-severity OpenSSL vulnerabilities, CVE-2022-3602 (remote code execution) and CVE-2022-3786 (Denial of Service), affecting OpenSSL versions 3.0.0 through 3.0.6. These vulnerabilities, now patched in version 3.0.7, relate to incorrect Punycode processing in X.509 certificates and can lead to stack corruption or remote code execution. Check Point products are not vulnerable, but other tech vendors need to upgrade their systems, and users are advised to stay alert and apply security best practices.

title: Newfold Digital completes MarkMonitor acquisition
summary: Newfold Digital has finalized its acquisition of MarkMonitor for $302.5 million from Clarivate Plc. MarkMonitor, a domain name registrar serving major brands like Amazon and Microsoft, will join Newfold Digital's portfolio, which includes Network Solutions and Register.com. This acquisition marks another instance of MarkMonitor changing private equity ownership, as Newfold Digital is backed by Clearlake Capital Group and Siris Capital Group.

title: A dash of flexibility enhances security at International Flavors and Fragrances
summary: International Flavors and Fragrances (IFF) is implementing a flexible security strategy, dubbed "security by obscurity," to secure its systems following a merger that doubled its size. Director of Information Security Architecture, Michael Strause, emphasizes identity as the primary defense in their zero-trust architecture, which was accelerated by the shift to hybrid work. IFF utilizes Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) for user-to-application segmentation, focusing on crown jewel applications and categorizing employees by function to manage complexity and ensure business agility.

title: Meet NetApp BlueXP
summary: NetApp has introduced BlueXP, a unified control plane designed to simplify hybrid multicloud data services, addressing the challenges of managing data across diverse environments. BlueXP offers features for enhanced simplicity, security, cost savings through AIOps and flexible consumption, and sustainability by providing insights into energy consumption. It aims to empower organizations to innovate quickly while optimizing performance, cost, and security of their data infrastructure.

title: NetApp BlueXP is a big step towards true hybrid cloud data management
summary: NetApp has launched BlueXP, a new management and configuration offering designed to streamline hybrid cloud data management. BlueXP acts as a control plane, providing centralized visibility, AIOps-driven management, cyber resilience features, and governance for data spread across on-premises and public cloud environments. The service is free for all NetApp customers, reflecting years of NetApp's strategic focus on deep multi-cloud integrations.

title: Inside Kforce’s new innovative hybrid HQ hub
summary: Kforce Inc. has unveiled its new 22,232-square-foot hybrid headquarters in Midtown Tampa, designed for an "office occasional" workforce model where employees are not required to work physically in the office. This innovative space, a fifth the size of their previous Ybor City office, emphasizes collaboration and offers various zones and advanced technology to support remote and in-office work. The company's decision was reinforced by a survey showing 93% of jobseekers prefer a hybrid remote setting, aligning with the evolving post-pandemic work landscape and addressing the soft office market.

title: Still Using Passwords? Get Started with Phishing-Resistant, Passwordless Authentication Now!
summary: Cisco Duo has made its passwordless authentication generally available across all Duo Editions. This solution aims to simplify the passwordless journey for organizations and supports a zero-trust security strategy by integrating with existing SAML identity providers or using Duo SSO. It offers flexible, phishing-resistant authentication options like FIDO2-compliant biometrics and Duo Mobile, enhancing user experience and mitigating credential-based risks.

title: Market Rallies Off Lows, but Expect Heightened Volatility to Persist
summary: The US stock market rallied in October, recouping some losses, and is still considered 15% undervalued by Morningstar as of October 31. Despite the recent gains, investors should prepare for continued volatility due to sluggish GDP, ongoing Fed tightening, and persistent inflation. Morningstar identifies communication services, technology, and cyclical sectors as offering the best value, while cautioning against the energy sector which is now overvalued.

title: Microsoft empowers partners to drive innovation in Sri Lanka and the Maldives
summary: Microsoft recently held its annual Partner Connect event in Colombo, Sri Lanka, to foster innovation and resilience within its partner network in Sri Lanka and the Maldives. The event emphasized enabling partners to help customers "Do More with Less" through five digital imperatives and recognized partners who successfully utilized Microsoft technologies. Microsoft also outlined its commitment to supporting governmental digital transformation and skills development in both countries.

title: SMBC partners Microsoft to integrate consumer and corporate businesses - Digital Transformation - Finance
summary: Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation Group (SMBC) is collaborating with Microsoft to enhance its digital transformation, focusing on "embedded finance" to integrate consumer and corporate businesses. This partnership aims to develop B2B2C platforms that offer customized financial solutions, reduce costs, and deliver personalized customer experiences globally. SMBC is leveraging Microsoft's cloud platform to create diverse services, including a cloud-based solution for supply chain issues and AI engines for digitizing trade finance, while also investing in non-financial digital tools and employee upskilling.

title: Oracle Layoffs Hit Its Cloud Unit
summary: Oracle has reportedly laid off about 200 employees in its cloud unit, specifically within the Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and North America Cloud Infrastructure and Technology (NACT) units. These layoffs are significant given Oracle's efforts to expand its share in the cloud market against competitors like AWS and Microsoft Azure. The company has also reportedly shifted its hiring focus away from major tech hubs to regions with lower salary expectations.

title: SAP Sustainability Control Tower: Creating the Right Data Foundation for ESG Reporting and Steering
summary: The SAP Sustainability Control Tower provides a software-as-a-service solution for companies to manage and report on their environmental, social, and governance (ESG) data. It offers critical functionalities for data quality, integration with various sources including SAP S/4HANA, and support for established reporting frameworks. Upcoming features include reporting for EU taxonomy and TCFD, and a greenhouse gas (GHG) analytical application to help customers understand and manage their emissions.

title: The anti-ESG funds exploiting the US political divide
summary: The article discusses the rise of anti-ESG funds in the US, which are exploiting the political divide by offering investments that prioritize shareholder value over socially responsible agendas. These funds, such as Strive Asset Management and ACVF, cater to investors who believe ESG investing is politically motivated and detrimental to financial returns. Despite their growing media attention, experts question their overall impact on corporate behavior and capital movement compared to traditional large asset managers.

title: HP Inc. stock falls Wednesday, underperforms market
summary: Shares of HP Inc. (HPQ) dropped 3.12% on Wednesday, closing at $26.98. This decline occurred during a broader market downturn, with the S&P 500 and Dow Jones Industrial Average also falling. HP Inc.'s stock underperformed the market and several competitors, ending significantly below its 52-week high.

title: Enhance Construction Asset & Equipment Tracking with the New BIM 360 Assets Module
summary: The new BIM 360 Assets Module helps construction teams track and manage various assets throughout the project lifecycle, from design to handover. It centralizes documentation, enables customization of asset statuses, and integrates with field management workflows. This module aims to accelerate commissioning, lower project costs, improve transparency, and reduce risks by providing a single source of truth for all asset-related information.

title: The Open AI Energy Initiative Welcomes Seven New Members
summary: The Open AI Energy Initiative (OAI) has welcomed seven new members: Aligned Automation, Infosys, EPAM Systems, Wipro, KBC, Akselos, and Databricks. These additions significantly expand the OAI's capabilities, particularly in system integration, and introduce a new category for modeling and simulation with KBC and Akselos. The initiative, launched by C3 AI, Shell, Baker Hughes, and Microsoft, aims to accelerate energy transition and optimize operations through AI-based solutions for the energy and process industries.

title: Cultivating a culture of learning at Microsoft with Viva Learning
summary: Microsoft is using its internal deployment of Microsoft Viva Learning to foster a strong learning culture, empower employees, and drive innovation. This platform centralizes learning experiences within Microsoft Teams, providing personalized recommendations and integrating existing learning resources. By acting as "Customer Zero," Microsoft uses its own internal experiences to refine Viva Learning, ensuring it meets both employee and customer needs.

title: Samsung sets sights on new chips for self-driving homes on wheels
summary: Samsung Electronics plans to develop specialized semiconductor chips for home appliances and future mobility vehicles like electric cars. This move comes as carmakers and electronics companies are integrating household features into autonomous vehicles, blurring the lines between home and car. Samsung aims to lead this emerging market for "homes on self-driving cars," with other companies like LG and Haier also investing in smart home and in-vehicle solutions.

title: Security-software stocks are suffering from this one gloomy forecast
summary: Security-software stocks, previously considered safe within the cloud-software sector, experienced a significant downturn this week. This decline is largely attributed to Fortinet Inc.'s gloomy forecast for fourth-quarter billings, which fell short of analysts' expectations. Fortinet executives noted a slowdown in closing large deals as companies become more cautious with spending, a trend now impacting the cybersecurity sector after affecting other software sectors earlier this year.

title: State of NJ Department of Community Affairs
summary: The State of New Jersey Department of Community Affairs (DCA) partnered with IBM Consulting to streamline aid distribution, particularly for utility debt relief, following the American Rescue Plan Act of 2021. IBM's solution, including portals and virtual agents, enabled the DCA to disperse over $127 million in aid and manage hundreds of thousands of calls, significantly improving efficiency and citizen access to critical assistance. This partnership allowed the DCA to quickly adapt to increased demand while maintaining service quality.

title: Raytheon Technologies collaborates with Microsoft to accelerate key business priorities through cloud adoption
summary: Raytheon Technologies is deepening its collaboration with Microsoft Corp. (Nasdaq: MSFT) to equip its employees with cloud-based tools, technologies, and platforms to enhance collaboration, optimize operations, and unlock intelligent insights. This partnership leverages Microsoft 365 and Azure to reduce data center footprint, accelerate speed-to-market for products, and drive data-driven insights through predictive analytics. The initiative aims to support business growth and operational excellence within the aerospace and defense company.

title: ServiceNow Releases New Solutions to Digitize Today’s Most Pressing Workplace Productivity Challenges
summary: ServiceNow announced new solutions, including Automated service suggestions, Service Request Playbook, and Workplace Scenario Planning, to tackle pressing workplace productivity challenges. These innovations leverage the ServiceNow platform to automate complex processes, improving service operations and experiences for customers, employees, and constituents across public and private sectors. The solutions aim to unlock value and cost-savings by driving greater efficiency in response to modern workplace issues and macro-economic influences.

title: 3 Hydrogen Stocks That Will Make You a Millionaire by 2030
summary: This article identifies three hydrogen stocks – Plug Power (PLUG), Bloom Energy (BE), and Ballard Power Systems (BLDP) – as potential millionaire-makers by 2030. It highlights hydrogen's versatility and the growing $11 trillion hydrogen economy, driven by energy and transportation needs. Each company is presented with its unique strengths, such as Plug Power's electrolyzer business and Microsoft partnership, Bloom Energy's solid-oxide fuel cells and financial targets, and Ballard Power Systems' leadership in fuel cells for heavy-duty vehicles.

title: At the frontier of the energy transition
summary: Pentagreen Capital, a joint venture between HSBC and Temasek, plans to invest USD1 billion in sustainable infrastructure projects in Southeast Asia, focusing on "marginally bankable" projects that traditional finance sources deem too risky or too small. CEO Marat Zapparov explains that they will target renewable energy, energy storage, water and waste treatment, and sustainable transportation, including innovative solutions like battery swap models for electric vehicles and plastic waste recycling infrastructure. The venture employs blended finance, combining private sector capital with more risk-tolerant catalytic capital, and benefits from HSBC’s commitment to sustainability, expertise, and global network.

title: Regeneron turns to IT to accelerate drug discovery
summary: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals is leveraging IT, particularly cloud computing and advanced data platforms, to significantly accelerate its drug discovery process. CIO Bob McCowan has spearheaded a major digital transformation, migrating the company's data to a multicloud environment (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and developing a MetaBio Data Discovery Platform, empowering scientists with tools to experiment and test hypotheses more efficiently. This strategic IT investment aims to reduce the drug development timeline from ten years to as few as four or five.

title: Amazon Continues its Cloud Expansion in Northern Virginia
summary: Amazon Web Services (AWS) is significantly expanding its data center presence in Northern Virginia by leasing large amounts of new space and increasing the size of its data centers. This expansion, primarily through its partnership with Corporate Office Properties Trust (COPT), signifies AWS's anticipation of strong future demand and its continued dominance in the cloud computing market. The article details COPT's role in building "powered shells" for Vadata (Amazon's data center operating unit) and highlights a shift towards larger data facility templates for AWS, ensuring continuous capital for COPT through joint ventures.

title: Researchers show techniques for malware persistence on F5 and Citrix load balancers
summary: Researchers from Eclypsium have demonstrated methods for achieving malware persistence on F5 and Citrix load balancers, challenging the assumption that only sophisticated APT groups can maintain such intrusions. This research highlights a growing vulnerability in network devices that function as full operating systems, making them attractive targets for attackers seeking stealthy, long-term access to corporate networks.

summary: Meta Platforms Inc. announced it is laying off over 11,000 employees, or 13 percent of its workforce, marking the largest job cut in the company's 18-year history. summary: Digital twins are rapidly evolving beyond their initial applications in discrete industrial products to encompass a wide range of industries and tasks, such as supply chains, healthcare, autonomous vehicles, and banking. This expansion is driven by their ability to generate insights, automate processes, and monitor assets, making them a strategic element of digital transformation. The article highlights the increasing complexity, the formation of new partnerships among solution providers, and the emergence of industry standards groups, emphasizing that digital twins will become an indispensable tool.

title: Tech firms pitch anti-Elon Musk management style in bid to woo former Twitter staff
summary: Following widespread layoffs and resignations at Twitter under Elon Musk's new ownership, several tech companies are actively recruiting former Twitter employees by critiquing Musk's management style. Companies like HubSpot, CoderPad, and Calix are emphasizing more employee-friendly cultures, remote work options, and opportunities for dissent to attract skilled tech talent. This recruitment drive highlights the high demand for experienced digital workers despite broader tech industry layoffs.

title: Microsoft offered Sony 10-year deal to keep Call of Duty on PlayStation, as regulatory pressure intensifies
summary: Microsoft has offered Sony a 10-year deal to keep Call of Duty on PlayStation, a move made as Microsoft seeks regulatory approval for its acquisition of Activision Blizzard. Sony has reportedly declined the offer and continues to oppose the deal, citing concerns about market competition and harm to consumers. Regulators in key markets like the UK, US, and EU remain skeptical about the acquisition.

title: HP says it will cut workforce by 4,000-6,000 by end of fiscal 2025
summary: HP Inc. announced plans to reduce its global workforce by 4,000 to 6,000 employees by the end of fiscal year 2025 as part of its "Future Ready Transformation" plan. This move is expected to incur approximately $700 million in labor costs. The computer manufacturer cited a challenging fourth quarter with net revenue down to $14.8 billion from $16.68 billion the previous year, and a 13% decrease in its personal systems segment.

title: Veritone buys Vision Semantics, gets Deloitte nod for growth
summary: Veritone has acquired Vision Semantics, a video recognition company, and released Tracker, a tool that uses AI algorithms to track objects without relying on personal biometric identification. The new software addresses privacy concerns by not using facial recognition. Additionally, Veritone was recognized on Deloitte's Fast 500 list for its rapid revenue growth, underscoring its success in providing AI services and solutions.

summary: Maria Alvarez, VP, AI Platform, Cloud and AI Division at Microsoft Corporation, will join Alkami Technology, Inc.'s Board of Directors effective January 1, 2023. She brings extensive experience in product strategy, operational and technical excellence, and digital transformation. This appointment follows the departure of Merline Saintil and Mike Hansen from the board.

title: Ciena Deepens Foray Into Access with Two Acquisitions
summary: Ciena Corp. is expanding its broadband access portfolio with two key acquisitions: Tibit Communications and Benu Networks. Tibit, acquired for approximately $210 million, specializes in pluggable optical line terminals for PONs, while Benu Networks, purchased for an undisclosed sum, offers a cloud-native platform for edge functions including virtual Broadband Network Gateways. These acquisitions aim to strengthen Ciena's presence in the lucrative broadband access market, which is a growing segment of its overall sales.

title: 4 Reasons Why Buying Airbnb Stock Is a Genius Move
summary: This article highlights four key reasons why Airbnb (ABNB) stock is considered a strong buy. These reasons include the company's robust growth despite economic concerns, its impressive profitability demonstrated by high free cash flow and profit margins, a reasonable valuation compared to historical data and peers, and the strong, founder-led leadership team that remains heavily invested in the company's success.

title: As the world goes digital, datacenters that make the cloud work look to renewable energy sources
summary: The article discusses the parallel trends of digitization and the shift to renewable energy, focusing on how datacenters are integrating sustainable practices. It highlights Microsoft's significant role in this transition through power purchase agreements (PPAs) that support new renewable energy projects. The piece also details innovative approaches by Microsoft datacenters in Europe, such as using waste heat for district heating and employing batteries for grid services, underscoring their commitment to carbon reduction and a sustainable future.

title: Microsoft signs 900MW PPAs for Ireland, 28% of nation's target for 2030
summary: Microsoft has secured Corporate Power Purchase Agreements (CPPAs) for 900MW to power its Irish data centers, covering 28% of Ireland's 2030 renewable energy target. This multi-year deal with Statkraft, Energia Group, and Power Capital Renewable Energy will bring new renewable power plants online, aiming for 100% renewable energy for Microsoft's Irish data centers by 2025. The announcement comes amidst challenges for data center development in Ireland due to power grid limitations.

title: Pegasystems updates CRM, RPA and low-code with Pega Infinity 8.8
summary: Pegasystems has released Pega Infinity 8.8, bringing significant updates to its CRM, RPA, and low-code solutions. Key enhancements include an AI-powered Developer Assistant Panel for Pega Platform, improved tools for Robotic Automation, and new pre-built data integrations for Pega Customer Decision Hub. The update also introduces 'call-wrapping' features in Pega Customer Service using AI transcription and enhanced integration between Customer Service and Customer Decision Hub.

title: HP Inc. stock rises Wednesday, outperforms market
summary: HP Inc. stock (HPQ) rose 1.80% to $29.91 on Wednesday, outperforming the broader market which also saw gains in the S&P 500 and Dow Jones Industrial Average. The stock closed $11.56 below its 52-week high and outperformed competitors like Apple Inc. and Microsoft Corp., though International Business Machines Corp. saw a slight decline. Trading volume for HP Inc. was significantly higher than its 50-day average.

title: Why Nokia’s 6G Wireless Technology Ambitions Could Make It a Top Cloud Enabler
summary: Nokia is positioning itself as a key cloud enabler by leading Europe's 6G rollout through the Hexa-X-II initiative, a consortium of 44 organizations. The article highlights how 6G's advancements in capacity, lower latency, reliability, and security are crucial for developing and adopting cloud technologies. Despite the slow 5G rollout, Nokia's focus on 6G aims to meet the accelerated demand for telecommunications infrastructure driven by cloud, automation, and immersive platforms.

summary: This article provides news and updates related to the ARK Next Generation Internet ETF (ARKW), featuring various headlines about Cathie Wood's ARK Invest activities. title: Microsoft empowers microentrepreneurs with digital skills and tools; From Jeli to the world
summary: Microsoft, in partnership with social enterprise Me.reka and MyDIGITAL Corporation, launched the 'Program Digital Usahawan Jeli' to equip microentrepreneurs in Jeli, Kelantan, with digital skills. Five selected entrepreneurs underwent a three-month virtual mentorship program focusing on sales, social media, and partnerships, leading to significant business growth and inspiring the 'Digital Entrepreneur Skills and Tools in a Box Programme' to scale these efforts. This initiative aims to bridge the digital divide and empower Malaysians, with Microsoft having achieved over 60% of its target to upskill 1 million Malaysians by 2023.

title: How to Back Up S3 Data using AWS Backup
summary: This article explains how to back up S3 data using AWS Backup, highlighting its features such as automated scheduling, incremental backups, and encryption. summary: This article provides details on the Dimensional U.S. Core Equity 2 ETF (DFAC), including its current price, key metrics, and how to invest in it through eToro. title: Employers Rethink Need for College Degrees in Tight Labor Market
summary: A tight labor market is leading more employers, including Google, Delta Air Lines, and IBM, to reduce college degree requirements for certain positions, focusing instead on skills and experience. This trend has resulted in a decline in job postings requiring bachelor's degrees compared to pre-pandemic levels. The shift is influenced by high demand for workers, low unemployment, and efforts to address racial disparities in the workplace.

title: BlackBerry makes its QNX operating system available on AWS
summary: BlackBerry has announced the availability of its QNX operating system on Amazon Web Services (AWS) cloud platform at AWS re:Invent 2022. QNX, a real-time operating system used in over 215 million vehicles globally, will enable automakers to develop and test new vehicle software more efficiently in the cloud using Amazon EC2 instances. This move also extends QNX's potential use to other industries like robotics, medical equipment, and aerospace.

title: Leveraging digital platforms to promote food security and sustainable agriculture in Africa
summary: IFC and Microsoft have partnered to support digital transformation in Africa's agriculture sector, focusing on promoting food security and sustainable agriculture. This collaboration aims to make digital tools and training accessible to small-scale farmers and agribusinesses, addressing inefficiencies and climate-related challenges. The initiative leverages tools like Microsoft's AgBot and Community Training applications to provide crucial information and enhance farming practices.

summary: This page provides news, articles, events, and latest updates for the Direxion Daily Small Cap Bull 3X Shares (TNA) ETF. title: Phoenix Data Centers: Colocation in the Silicon Desert
summary: Phoenix, Arizona has become the United States' fourth-largest data center market, boasting over 90 data centers and 600 megawatts of commissioned power. This growth is fueled by lower power costs, abundant real estate, and tax incentives, attracting hyperscalers and major enterprises. The article details the market's key players, connectivity, and the factors contributing to its emergence as a Tier-1 data center hub, while also addressing challenges like climate and water usage concerns.

title: Amazon Launches Supply-Chain Software Service
summary: Amazon.com Inc. has introduced "AWS Supply Chain," a new cloud-based software service designed to help businesses manage and track cargo flows. This move positions Amazon as a competitor to existing supply-chain software providers such as Manhattan Associates and Blue Yonder, and follows a similar launch by Microsoft Corp. The service aims to assist businesses, especially the numerous small and medium-sized businesses in Amazon's marketplace, in gaining better control over their complex supply chains.

title: Oracle Corp. stock underperforms Tuesday when compared to competitors
summary: Oracle Corp. (ORCL) stock fell 0.66% on Tuesday, closing at $80.85, a second consecutive day of losses. This performance was in contrast to some competitors like Microsoft Corp. and Alphabet Inc. which also experienced declines, but Oracle underperformed the broader S&P 500 Index. The stock is significantly below its 52-week high, and trading volume was below its 50-day average.

title: Ibens cuts Review Turnaround Times by 75% and Fuels Highest Quality Outcomes
summary: Belgian construction company Ibens has significantly reduced review turnaround times by 75% and improved project outcomes by implementing Autodesk Construction Cloud’s BIM 360 solution. This platform enabled them to deliver their first school construction project three months ahead of schedule by streamlining collaboration, improving data accessibility, and enhancing communication with clients and partners. Ibens aims to further innovate by developing an intelligent self-learning system from their accumulated project data.

title: GE Healthcare, MediView XR partner to launch augmented reality X-ray imaging system
summary: GE Healthcare and MediView XR have teamed up to introduce OmnifyXR, an augmented reality system for interventional X-ray imaging. This technology integrates Microsoft's HoloLens with GE Healthcare's imaging systems, aiming to enhance physician workflows, improve ergonomics, and facilitate remote collaboration. The partners plan to initially launch the product in the U.S. and later expand globally.

title: Amazon Launches Supply-Chain Software Service
summary: Amazon Web Services has launched a new supply-chain software service, entering the burgeoning tech sector that aims to bring more efficiency and visibility to goods management. This move positions Amazon alongside established players like Blue Yonder and SAP, as well as other big operators such as Microsoft, in helping businesses navigate supply chain disruptions. The service is expected to find a ready audience among the thousands of small- and medium-sized businesses on Amazon's third-party marketplace.

title: Spotify CEO renews attack on Apple after Musk's salvo
summary: Spotify's CEO Daniel Ek criticized Apple in a series of tweets, accusing the iPhone maker of stifling innovation and hurting consumers by giving itself every advantage. This attack follows similar criticism from Elon Musk regarding Apple's in-app purchase fees. Spotify has previously filed antitrust complaints against Apple over its 30% charge, which it claims artificially inflates its prices.

title: Elastic Lays Off Nearly 400 Employees as SMB Spend Dwindles
summary: Elastic, a security, observability, and search vendor, is laying off nearly 400 employees, representing 13% of its workforce, due to reduced spending by small and medium businesses. The company plans to transition to an automated, low-touch approach for SMB customers and reallocate resources towards larger enterprises. This move aligns with similar trends observed by other security vendors facing a challenging economic environment.

title: HPE is in talks to buy Nutanix: Report
summary: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) is reportedly in discussions to acquire cloud computing firm Nutanix. This potential acquisition could establish HPE as a dominant force in the cloud computing market and allow it to cross-sell growth-oriented software to its extensive customer base. Experts suggest that while the deal could benefit HPE with lower operational costs and a larger market share, customers might face higher pricing for cloud services post-acquisition.

title: Global investment banking firm blazes new trail to remote work with complete cloud-delivered security
summary: Jefferies, a global investment banking firm, has successfully transitioned its entire global workforce to a secure remote work environment by leveraging Palo Alto Networks' Prisma Access. This cloud-delivered security platform addressed challenges related to complexity, risk, and data loss prevention in a hybrid work model, particularly accelerated by the pandemic. The solution enabled Jefferies to unify security policies, provide a seamless user experience, and ensure the protection of highly sensitive client data across its worldwide operations.

title: With Prisma Cloud, a leading finance and insurance company in Asia sees 99.52% compliance
summary: A major finance and insurance company in Asia achieved 99.52% compliance with Prisma Cloud, consolidating multiple cloud sites into a single tenant for improved visibility and workload protection. The company's key challenges included managing alert fatigue and meeting compliance requirements, which were addressed through proactive policy management and strong internal controls. This partnership with Palo Alto Networks led to significant improvements in cloud security posture and reporting.

title: Vodafone Picks Dubber for UK and European Business Strategy
summary: Vodafone Group PLC has partnered with Dubber, a Melbourne-based conversational intelligence and unified recording company, to deliver direct recording and AI services across its mobile networks for business customers in the UK and Europe, starting with Germany. This collaboration will leverage Dubber's platform to provide enhanced compliance and data insights across mobile and UC services, including RingCentral, Cisco Webex, and Microsoft Teams. The initiative aims to expand Vodafone's existing recording subscriber base and generate accretive revenue for Dubber by offering automated, self-service next-generation recordings and personalized customer experiences.

title: CrowdStrike Vs Zscaler: Which Stock is Better?
summary: This article compares two prominent cybersecurity companies, CrowdStrike (CRWD) and Zscaler (ZS), highlighting their distinct but complementary services and similar market opportunities. While CrowdStrike focuses on endpoint protection using AI, Zscaler is a leader in zero-trust access control. The analysis suggests that both companies offer strong investment potential in the cybersecurity sector, with the author ultimately favoring CrowdStrike due to its modular approach and clear investment deck.

title: Salesforce shares tumble after surprise exit of co-CEO Taylor
summary: Salesforce Inc (CRM.N) shares fell by about 10% after co-CEO Bret Taylor's unexpected departure, raising concerns about the company's co-CEO leadership model and slowing revenue growth. This exit prompted at least 17 brokerages to cut their price targets on the stock, with analysts noting it as a significant blow given Taylor's leadership role in product development. Taylor's departure comes after just one year in the co-CEO role, leaving co-founder Marc Benioff as the sole top boss.

title: BJ’s connects advertisers with customers across channels
summary: BJ's Wholesale Club is launching its own retail media network called BJ’s Media Edge, in collaboration with Microsoft PromoteIQ. This platform aims to connect advertisers with its 6.5 million members across various channels, providing real-time analytics and data. This move follows a similar trend in retail, with Sam's Club also expanding its advertising solutions.

title: PepsiCo transforms for the digital era
summary: PepsiCo is undergoing a significant five-year digital transformation led by Chief Strategy and Transformation Officer Athina Kanioura, focusing on cloud, analytics, automation, and upskilling its 300,000 employees. The company has migrated 5,000 applications to Microsoft Azure and is refining its data analytics and deploying AI-enhanced robotics, leading to positive financial KPIs and an expected 12% growth for the current fiscal year. A key aspect of the transformation is employee buy-in and upskilling through initiatives like the PepsiCo Digital Academy, alongside establishing Digital Hubs to create new digital jobs.

title: The clearing house standard: Aspirational model for accounting firms and retailers
summary: Accounting firms, particularly those serving the retail industry, should adopt a "clearing house mentality" to improve the accuracy of client bookkeeping and save them money. This approach involves daily reconciliation of sales and deposits, similar to the highly regulated investment industry, to address the complexities of modern e-commerce and diverse payment platforms. By educating clients and leveraging automation, firms can provide a more robust reconciliation experience, preventing financial discrepancies and ensuring better financial health for retailers.

title: 7 Quantum Computing Stocks to Buy for the Next 10 Years
summary: This article highlights seven quantum computing stocks poised for significant growth over the next decade, as quantum computing transitions from theory to reality and disrupts various industries. It details how major tech companies like Alphabet, IBM, and Microsoft are leading the charge, alongside smaller players like Quantum Computing and Chinese giants Alibaba and Baidu, as well as Intel in hardware development. The author emphasizes the transformative power of quantum computing and the potential for these companies to be big winners.

title: Nutanix buyout may be on the cards with HPE sniffing around
summary: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) is reportedly considering acquiring hyperconverged infrastructure vendor Nutanix, with discussions ongoing for several months. The potential acquisition aligns with HPE's GreenLake everything-as-a-service (XaaS) platform strategy, aiming to enhance its software offerings and attract more customers. Nutanix's recent financial recovery and improved market cap make it an attractive target, especially given HPE's struggles in expanding the GreenLake model to its global partners.

title: Microsoft advances plan for new $400M Loudoun data center
summary: Microsoft is nearing final permit approval for a new $400 million data center project in Loudoun County, Virginia. The site plan for this fast-track development has already received approval. This initiative is part of a larger trend of data center development in the region.

title: Why Lumen Technologies Fell 25.7% in November
summary: Lumen Technologies' stock plunged 25.7% in November following the company's announcement of a dividend suspension and disappointing Q3 earnings. Despite continued revenue and profit declines, a new CEO and recent asset sales provide capital that could be used for debt reduction or growth acceleration. The stock now trades at a low multiple of its estimated free cash flow, potentially attracting deep-value investors.

title: How suite of dividend growth ETFs brings quality to the fore
summary: In an environment of market volatility and economic uncertainty, CI WisdomTree ETFs offer a quality-focused core portfolio solution that has outperformed benchmarks.
