This strategy aims to provide diversified large-cap exposure and long-term stability by avoiding overvalued companies and focusing on profitable dividend payers, proving particularly effective during periods of economic contraction.

title: Rackspace Security Incident Causes Thousands To Lose Email Service
summary: Thousands of Rackspace customers lost email service after a security incident caused a weekend-long outage impacting its hosted Exchange. Rackspace began restoring services to Microsoft 365 customers and confirmed the incident was security-related, advising a move to Microsoft 365 for affected users. The incident led to significant customer frustration and a 10 percent drop in Rackspace's stock.

title: Microsoft Is Raising Price of New Xbox Games to $70 Starting Next Year
summary: Microsoft (MSFT) announced it will increase the price of its new Xbox games to $70 starting in 2023, following similar moves by other major gaming companies. This $10 price hike will apply to next-generation titles like Starfield, Redfall, and Forza Motorsport, with the company stating it reflects the content's scale and technical complexity. These games will also be accessible through Microsoft’s Game Pass subscription service.

title: Check out the Polaris Slingshot 2023 Lineup

The 2023 Slingshot models, including the S, S with Technology Package, SL, SLR, and R, offer various styling, performance, and comfort upgrades, with pricing detailed for each model.

title: Email hosting service Rackspace says it's facing a ransomware attack
summary: Rackspace Technology, a major cloud and email hosting provider, announced a ransomware attack is responsible for a widespread outage that has kept some customers from their email inboxes since Friday. The company revealed the attack may lead to revenue loss for its Hosted Exchange business and has hired a cyber defense firm to investigate, but cannot provide a restoration timeline. Customers are complaining about a lack of communication and support as they are advised to migrate to Microsoft 365, with concerns about data security and the difficulty of the migration process.

title: Rackspace Hosted Exchange failure due to 'ransomware incident'; company faces class-action lawsuit
summary: Rackspace Technology Inc. announced that the major failure of its Hosted Exchange service was due to a "ransomware incident," affecting thousands of customers for five days. Rackspace stated it's investigating with a cyber defense firm and migrating affected customers to Microsoft 365, while its stock price has dropped significantly.

title: Building the future of retail with Adobe and Dynamics 365
summary: Microsoft is revamping its online store on microsoft.com by integrating Adobe Experience Cloud, Microsoft Dynamics 365, and Microsoft Azure. This initiative aims to improve content management efficiency for developers and create a more accessible and intuitive interface for customers. The shift replaces an internal custom solution with a suite of Adobe products linked to Dynamics 365 Commerce, hosted on Azure, to enhance scalability and adaptability for Microsoft Store's digital storefronts.

title: Pison Technology Appoints John Croteau as CEO
summary: Pison Technology, a pioneer in neural biosensing with AI-powered Electroneurography (ENG) for health, fitness, and smart device control, has appointed semiconductor industry veteran John Croteau as its new chief executive officer. Croteau, who joined Pison in January 2022, aims to embed biosensors in consumer smartwatches for Neural Health and Fitness apps and 3D Touchless controls. His appointment is expected to drive the company's transition to commercial markets through strategic partnerships and operational scaling.

title: Introduction: Chuck Gahun, Principal Analyst For Content Management And Digital Experience Technology
summary: Chuck Gahun joins Forrester as Principal Analyst for Content Management and Digital Experience Technology, focusing on the intersection of content technologies and digital business strategy. His research will explore competitive digital business strategies, emphasizing the critical role of content in customer acquisition and growth, and the development of digital experience ecosystems. Gahun brings over 30 years of digital and agency experience to his new role.

title: HPE GreenLake For Private Cloud Packs New AWS Kubernetes Punch
summary: HPE has enhanced its GreenLake for Private Cloud Enterprise platform, notably integrating with AWS’ Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS) Anywhere. This expansion offers significant new services opportunities for partners and allows customers to deploy AWS Kubernetes in various private cloud environments. The updates also include new analytics for multi-cloud consumption, six new workload-optimized instances, and planned integrations with other Kubernetes platforms like Red Hat OpenShift.

title: For HPE, The Cloud Is A Private And A Public Matter
summary: HPE is focusing on its GreenLake utility platform to expand its presence in the hybrid cloud market, emphasizing private cloud offerings. The company aims to make its entire portfolio available as a service and is seeing steady growth in GreenLake's orders and revenue. HPE is enhancing GreenLake with new services like Private Cloud Enterprise and expanding partner offerings, catering to businesses that prefer a mix of public and private cloud solutions, especially for edge computing needs.

title: AWS, Google, Microsoft and Oracle all get a piece of the Pentagon's $9B JWCC cloud computing contract
summary: The Pentagon has awarded Amazon Web Services, Microsoft, Google, and Oracle shared portions of a $9 billion Joint Warfighting Cloud Capability (JWCC) contract, which will run through 2028. This multi-vendor approach replaces the previously controversial single-award JEDI contract and aligns with industry best practices of using multiple cloud providers for resilience and cost management. Analysts view this distributed award as a positive step, promoting competition and allowing the DOD to leverage the best capabilities of each cloud provider.

title: Rackspace Incident Highlights How Disruptive Attacks on Cloud Providers Can Be
summary: A December 2 ransomware attack on Rackspace Technology's Hosted Exchange environment disrupted email services for thousands of small and midsize businesses, leading to customer frustration, a class-action lawsuit, and a significant drop in its share price. The incident underscores the disruptive potential of attacks on cloud service providers and highlights the shared responsibility in cloud security. Rackspace advised customers to migrate to Microsoft 365, with the company unable to provide a timeline for restoring its own Hosted Exchange environment.

title: Amazon.com Inc. stock outperforms market on strong trading day
summary: Amazon.com Inc. (AMZN) shares rose by 0.24% to $88.46 on a day when the broader market saw declines, ending a four-day losing streak. The stock's performance outpaced major competitors like Apple, Microsoft, and Alphabet. Amazon closed significantly below its 52-week high, with trading volume also below its 50-day average.

title: How Kraft Heinz boosted manager support and training
summary: Kraft Heinz, under CPO Melissa Werneck, implemented a "year of the manager" initiative to significantly improve manager support and training after discovering only one in ten people are naturally wired to be managers. This strategy involved expanding their learning resources, encouraging employee ownership of learning through 'Ownerversity,' and deploying the Humu coaching platform to scale manager development. The success of the program is measured through feedback, 360 assessments, and employee retention, demonstrating improved manager satisfaction and coaching skills.

title: Pentagon Divides Big Cloud-Computing Deal Among 4 Firms (Published 2022)
summary: The Pentagon awarded lucrative cloud-computing contracts, potentially valued at up to $9 billion, to Amazon, Google, Microsoft, and Oracle. This decision marks a significant shift from an earlier attempt to award a sole contract to Microsoft, which was later scrapped after legal challenges and a recognition that the department's needs had evolved. The new Joint Warfighting Cloud Capability project aims to provide comprehensive cloud services across all security domains and classification levels for the Defense Department.

title: Google, Oracle, Amazon, Microsoft to share $9 billion ‘return of JEDI’ defense contract
summary: Google, Oracle, Amazon, and Microsoft will jointly share a $9 billion hybrid contract from the Pentagon to provide secure cloud services globally. The contract, known as Joint Warfighting Cloud Capability, is scheduled for completion by June 8, 2028, with work to be performed in Reston, Va. This agreement follows previous discussions and changes regarding the Department of Defense's cloud computing needs.

title: Rackspace Valuation Falls Below $1 Billion Amid MSP Ransomware Attack
summary: Rackspace Technology's market capitalization has fallen below $1 billion following a Hosted Exchange ransomware attack that disrupted email services for some customers. This cyberattack exacerbates existing business challenges, as the company's valuation has declined significantly from $8 billion in 2020 and its revenue growth lags behind the broader MSP and MSSP markets. Rackspace is now offering free Microsoft 365 services to impacted customers and undergoing a business realignment, with its future strategy potentially influenced by the attack.

title: Brad Miller Joins Moderna as Chief Information Officer
summary: Moderna, Inc. has announced the appointment of Brad Miller as Chief Information Officer, effective January 3, 2023. Miller will join Moderna's Executive Committee, reporting to CEO Stéphane Bancel. He takes over from Marcello Damiani, the current Chief Digital Officer, who will be retiring in March after seven and a half years with the company.

title: ERISA Suits Against Capital One and Booz Allen Hamilton Dismissed
summary: A U.S. District Court judge dismissed two ERISA lawsuits against Capital One and Booz Allen Hamilton, which alleged fiduciary breaches due to their use of BlackRock target-date funds as qualified default investment alternatives. The plaintiffs, represented by Miller Shah LLP, have two weeks to amend their complaint and stated they are likely to refile, arguing that the court did not fully understand investment products and fiduciary evaluations. Critics of the lawsuits contend that the BlackRock TDFs are top-rated and that the claims are without merit.

title: F.T.C. Sues to Block Microsoft’s $69 Billion Acquisition of Activision (Published 2022)
summary: The Federal Trade Commission has sued to block Microsoft's $69 billion acquisition of video game maker Activision Blizzard, citing concerns that the deal would harm consumers by allowing Microsoft to withhold popular games like Call of Duty from rivals. This aggressive move by the F.T.C. signals a stronger regulatory stance against the expansion of big tech companies. Microsoft has stated its intention to fight the lawsuit in court to proceed with the acquisition.

title: Indian Engineering and Construction enterprises accelerate cloud adoption to enhance their customer experience
summary: Indian Engineering and Construction (E&C) enterprises are increasingly adopting SAP's cloud ERP solution, 'RISE with SAP,' to drive digital transformation, enhance customer experience, and become future-ready. Key players like Prestige Estates Projects, Pacific Development Corporation, and Nambiar Builders have already implemented RISE with SAP to simplify supply chains, finance processes, and achieve 100% uptime, highlighting a growing demand for cloud technology across the sector. This shift enables businesses to unlock new opportunities, improve operational efficacy, and become more agile and sustainable intelligent enterprises.

title: A dip in Alder Lake with an HP Elitebook is spoiled by avoidable mistakes
summary: The HP Elitebook 1040 x360 g9, featuring an Intel Alder Lake CPU, offers solid performance and thoughtful additions but is marred by several design flaws and software issues. Reviewer Simon Sharwood notes its speed in benchmarks and daily tasks but criticizes the poor keyboard, inconvenient port placement, useless tablet mode, and excessive pre-installed "nagware." Despite its processing power, the laptop ultimately feels uninspired and fails to deliver a "fresh perspective" often sought in the "Desktop Tourism" series.

title: First Trust/abrdn Emerging Opportunity Fund Announces Termination and Liquidation
summary: The First Trust/abrdn Emerging Opportunity Fund (NYSE: FEO) completed its termination and liquidation on December 7, 2022, as consistent with its plan announced on September 20, 2022. Shareholders received a liquidating distribution of $9.635572 per common share. Investors are advised to consult a tax advisor regarding the tax implications of this liquidation.

title: Pentagon splits $9 billion cloud contract among Google, Amazon, Oracle and Microsoft
summary: The Pentagon awarded $9 billion worth of cloud computing contracts to Google, Amazon Web Services, Microsoft, and Oracle. These Joint Warfighting Cloud Capability (JWCC) contracts will provide enterprise-wide cloud services across all security domains and classification levels until 2028. This move signifies the military's shift towards utilizing multiple vendors for its cloud computing needs, learning from past litigation that halted a single-vendor IT modernization project.

title: Pentagon awards multibillion-dollar cloud contract to Amazon, Google, Microsoft and Oracle
summary: The Pentagon has awarded a multibillion-dollar cloud computing contract, Joint Warfighting Cloud Capability (JWCC), to Amazon, Google, Microsoft, and Oracle. This move diverges from a previous single-vendor approach (JEDI contract) that faced legal challenges from Amazon alleging interference by former President Trump. The new multi-vendor contract, worth up to $9 billion, aims to provide resilient and cost-effective cloud services for the military, enabling access to sensitive data globally.

title: Microsoft’s law firm diversity program: celebrating top performers in 2022
summary: Microsoft's Chief Legal Officer, Hossein Nowbar, discusses the company's 2022 Law Firm Diversity Program (LFDP) results. The program, now in its 14th year, incentivizes law firms to achieve diversity representation goals, focusing on increasing diversity in leadership roles. While overall progress in diverse partnership ranks saw modest increases, Microsoft celebrates firms that have significantly advanced diversity within their organizations.

title: P&G Doubles Down on Digital Capacity and Shelf Orchestration With Supply Chain 3.0
summary: Procter & Gamble is heavily investing in its Supply Chain 3.0 strategy, leveraging emerging technologies and advanced algorithms to drive productivity, cost effectiveness, and market growth. This digital transformation includes partnerships with companies like Microsoft for a digital platform utilizing IoT, AI, machine learning, and edge computing to enhance visibility and real-time decision-making across its manufacturing sites globally. P&G is also applying these advancements to optimize shelf orchestration based on point-of-sale data and shopper behavior, aiming to improve on-shelf availability and the overall shopping experience.

title: Watch Out For TuringBots: A New Generation Of Software Development
summary: TuringBots, AI-powered software coined by Forrester, are revolutionizing software development by augmenting human capabilities across planning, design, building, testing, and deployment. While not replacing human developers, these tools significantly enhance efficiency and intelligence in the software development lifecycle. Organizations are advised to understand the technology, adopt strategic implementation for tester and coder TuringBots, and stay informed through ongoing research to navigate this evolving landscape.

title: Coca-Cola United automates over 50,000 orders in complex SAP invoicing process with Microsoft Power Platform
summary: Coca-Cola United has significantly improved its operational efficiency by using Microsoft Power Platform to automate two key processes: on-demand shipment requests and a complex SAP invoicing process. The automation reduced order validation time from half a day to seconds and enabled the processing of over 50,000 orders, freeing up valuable employee time and supporting strategic growth. The company plans to continue automating more business processes using Microsoft Power Automate RPA capabilities, further reducing labor costs and improving accuracy.

title: Microsoft acquires Lumenisity®, an innovator in hollow core fiber (HCF) cable
summary: Microsoft has acquired Lumenisity® Limited, a leader in hollow core fiber (HCF) solutions, to enhance its global cloud infrastructure and address the strict latency and security requirements of its Cloud Platform and Services customers. Lumenisity's HCF technology offers increased speed, lower latency, enhanced security, and lower costs compared to traditional fiber, benefiting sectors like healthcare, financial services, manufacturing, retail, and government. This acquisition will enable Microsoft to accelerate innovations in networking and infrastructure by integrating Lumenisity’s technology and expert team.

title: BlackRock seeks to capitalise on metaverse through new ETF
summary: BlackRock has launched a new exchange-traded fund (ETF) called iShare Metaverse UCITS to allow European clients exposure to companies developing metaverse technologies. This ETF tracks the STOXX Global Metaverse Index, which identifies market leaders and innovators through patent data analysis. The initiative aims to capitalize on the rapidly growing metaverse market, predicted to reach US$4-5 trillion by 2030, offering investors a diversified portfolio in this emerging technological space.

title: New Technique Discovered To Bypass Web Application Firewalls (WAF) Of Several Vendors
summary: Cybersecurity experts at Claroty have developed a new generic method to bypass Web Application Firewalls (WAFs) from multiple leading manufacturers. This technique was discovered while researching a SQL injection flaw in Cambium Networks' wireless device management platform. The bypass abuses the default JSON syntax support in SQL engines to craft new, less common SQLi payloads that can evade WAF detection.

title: Selling experiences: Growing your business and making clients happy
summary: The experiences industry, encompassing tours, activities, and attractions, is the third-largest sector in travel and is expected to surpass pre-pandemic gross bookings by 2024. Despite its fragmented nature and a significant number of operators lagging in digitization, the internet has made it easier for providers to gain visibility. Travel advisors play a crucial role in navigating this complex sector, using preferred partners to ensure clients have memorable experiences and build advisor credibility, even if commissions are smaller than other travel segments.

title: You Need A Design System — Here’s Why
summary: The article highlights the growing importance of design systems in organizations, driven by the increasing recognition of design's business value. It explains that design systems democratize design practice, support accessibility efforts, and improve talent retention by enabling designers to focus on more challenging and innovative work rather than repetitive tasks. The author encourages companies to adopt and effectively utilize design systems.

title: Consoles and Competition
summary: This article traces the tumultuous history of the video game console market, highlighting the shifting dynamics between hardware manufacturers and third-party developers, from Atari's integrated system to Sony's third-party focus and later emphasis on exclusives. It critically examines the FTC's attempt to block Microsoft's acquisition of Activision, arguing that the FTC's concerns fail to understand the industry's dynamic evolution and Microsoft's innovative subscription-based business model, which offers a competitive alternative to Sony's platform-locking exclusive strategy. The author suggests that the FTC is trying to preserve an outdated model of competition and is missing the real antitrust issues concerning dominant storefronts.

title: IBM Remains Big Tech’s Disaster
summary: The article portrays IBM as a struggling legacy technology company that has failed to keep pace with its Big Tech counterparts. Despite its historical dominance, IBM missed critical opportunities in personal computing and cloud computing, leading to a significantly smaller market capitalization and lower revenue compared to industry leaders like Microsoft and Apple. Wall Street analysts maintain a "Hold" rating, with price targets below its current trading price, suggesting a bleak outlook for the company's future performance.

title: Earnings Previews: Arqit Quantum, Scorpio Tankers, Weber
summary: This article provides earnings previews for Arqit Quantum, Scorpio Tankers, and Weber, all set to report results on Wednesday morning. It details each company's financial expectations, stock performance, analyst ratings, and relevant business developments. The broader market context, including forthcoming economic data releases and recent market movements, is also discussed.

title: Microsoft invests $2 billion in London Stock Exchange cloud deal
summary: Microsoft is acquiring a 4% stake in the London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) for $2 billion, marking a significant cloud partnership between the two entities. This deal aims to integrate Microsoft's applications with LSEG's products, broaden its customer base, and explore shifting trading activities to the cloud. The move highlights the increasing convergence between Big Tech and financial services, drawing scrutiny from regulators concerned about concentration risks in cloud providers.

title: SPDR Gender Diversity ETF Officially Changes Index, Name
summary: The SPDR MSCI USA Gender Diversity ETF (SHE) has officially changed its name and underlying index to the MSCI USA Gender Diversity Select Index, effective December 8. This ETF, a pioneer in gender-focused investing with $208.65 million in assets, now holds 281 stocks. The new index emphasizes companies committed to gender diversity across all organizational levels and rebalances quarterly.

title: SPDR Gender Diversity ETF Officially Changes Index, Name
summary: The SPDR MSCI USA Gender Diversity ETF (SHE) has officially changed its underlying index and name to the MSCI USA Gender Diversity Select Index. This ETF, a pioneer in gender-focused funds with $208.65 million in assets, now holds 281 stocks and seeks to identify companies committed to gender diversity across all organizational levels. The index is sector-agnostic, with holdings weighted by market capitalization and gender diversity scores.

title: Discovering diamonds in the rough
summary: The insurance industry is facing a significant talent shortage, with a large percentage of the current workforce set to retire and a lack of interest from younger generations. To address this, MetLife organized the Hack4Job 2022 Virtual Hackathon, a global initiative to identify and recruit tech talent. The event, supported by various national digital players, focused on critical tech areas and resulted in job offers for successful candidates, with plans to expand the hackathon globally.

title: Microsoft, Nike and Common Energy partner on community solar in Oregon
summary: Microsoft, Nike, and Common Energy have partnered on the Skyward Community Solar project in Oregon, a 2.5 MWac facility now fully operational and subscribed. The project, owned by Standard Solar, will generate 3.6 million kilowatt-hours of clean energy annually, feeding into the Portland General Electric grid. Microsoft is the primary commercial subscriber, while Nike employees subscribe to the residential portion, and 10% of the generation is allocated to low- and moderate-income households receiving substantial bill discounts.

title: AI-generated content helping redefine industry
summary: Chinese tech companies are significantly investing in the artificial intelligence-generated content (AIGC) sector, driven by the success of models like ChatGPT. Experts believe AIGC will revolutionize content creation by assisting humans and eventually generating content independently, with diverse applications in industries from finance to education. Companies like Baidu, ByteDance, and Kuaishou are already deploying AI-powered tools, signaling a major shift in content production and innovation.

title: Annual Shareholders Meeting 2022
summary: Microsoft's Annual Shareholders Meeting for 2022 covered financial performance, strategic priorities, and shareholder proposals. Key topics included record financial results in FY22, investments in AI and cloud computing, and responses to shareholder concerns regarding diversity, fair chance employment, climate change, government contracts, and tax transparency. The leadership team also discussed balancing strategic growth with cost management and the ongoing FTC lawsuit regarding the Activision Blizzard acquisition.

title: QGRW ETF Profile: Dividends, Returns (BMV:QGRW)
summary: This article provides a detailed profile of the QGRW ETF (WisdomTree U.S. Quality Growth Fund), traded on the Mexican Stock Exchange (BMV). It covers key statistics such as AUM, expense ratio, and inception date, along with its investment strategy targeting profitability and high-conviction allocations in the U.S. equity market. The profile also includes information on its asset allocation, top holdings like NVIDIA and Microsoft, dividend history, and recent performance metrics.

title: What’s It Like To Be A Black Woman In Corporate America? Here’s One Inspiring Story
summary: This article features an interview with Tiffany West Polk, a Black female managing director and CTO at JPMorgan Chase, who discusses her experiences and insights as a Black woman in corporate America, particularly in the tech field. She shares her journey, how her upbringing in Texas shaped her, her strategies for success in a challenging environment, and her commitment to mentoring other Black women. Polk also emphasizes the importance of authenticity, understanding business value in tech, and prioritizing self-care amidst a demanding career.

title: Now, Near, Next: How Software Startups Can Accelerate Growth in Uncertain Times
summary: In uncertain economic times, software startups can leverage the "Now, Near, Next" framework to maintain agility and accelerate growth. This framework helps businesses assess current challenges, identify near-term focus areas, and plan for future market conditions. By implementing these strategies, startups can outperform competitors and prepare for accelerated growth when economic conditions improve.

title: Why Kodak Died and Fujifilm Thrived: A Tale of Two Film Companies
summary: This article analyzes why Kodak, once a giant in the film industry, ultimately failed, while its competitor Fujifilm managed to thrive despite the digital revolution. It attributes Kodak's downfall to its inability to diversify beyond the declining photo industry and its misjudgment of the digital market's profitability. In contrast, Fujifilm successfully leveraged its existing technologies and pursued aggressive diversification into new markets like pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, and highly functional materials, demonstrating a more adventurous and adaptable corporate culture.

title: Expanding our commitments in Africa: Connectivity and skills
summary: Microsoft is expanding its commitments in Africa by focusing on digital connectivity and skills building. This includes growing the Airband Initiative to provide internet access to 100 million Africans by 2025 through new partnerships, notably with Viasat. Additionally, Microsoft will expand its Skills for Jobs program in Africa to include a new cybersecurity skilling program, addressing the continent's growing need for digital defense expertise.

title: Microsoft and Viasat Partner to Provide Satellite Internet Services to Underrepresented Communities in Africa
summary: Microsoft and Viasat have partnered to provide satellite internet services to 10 million people globally, with a focus on connecting 5 million people in Africa by 2025 through Microsoft's Airband initiative. The project, starting in Angola, Egypt, and Senegal, aims to bridge the digital divide by offering services like telehealth and distance learning. This collaboration leverages Microsoft's existing relationship with Viasat Azure Space and benefits from simplified licensing procedures in many African countries.

title: Run SQL Server on EC2 using FSx for ONTAP
summary: This article discusses the benefits of running SQL Server on Amazon EC2 with FSx for NetApp ONTAP, highlighting how it addresses migration challenges from on-premises environments. It delves into various use cases, including simplified database backup and restore processes using NetApp SnapCenter, efficient test recovery, DevOps cloning, and disaster recovery/migration using SnapMirror. The integration provides enterprise-grade storage capabilities, high performance, and cost optimization for SQL workloads in the AWS cloud.

title: Celebrity Cruises Launches the World's First Digital Cruise Ship Experience in the metaverse
summary: Celebrity Cruises has launched the "Wonderverse," the world's first digital cruise ship experience in the metaverse, allowing travelers to explore a hyper-realistic digital recreation of its Celebrity Beyond ship. This interactive platform enables prospective guests to tour iconic spaces, experience signature brand moments, and virtually interact with key leaders and designers like Captain Kate McCue and Nate Berkus. The initiative aims to revolutionize how travelers discover and book cruise vacations by offering an immersive "see before you sail" experience ahead of the holidays.

title: Arqit Quantum Inc. Announces Financial and Operational Results for the Fiscal Year 2022
summary: Arqit Quantum Inc. announced its financial and operational results for the fiscal year ended September 30, 2022, reporting $20 million in revenue and other operating income. A significant technological innovation means the company no longer needs to build quantum satellites, leading to expected positive impacts on future financial results and a refocusing of its go-to-market strategy through major channel partnerships. The company also detailed key operational highlights, including integrations with Fortinet, Amazon Web Services, and Dell Technologies, and announced awards and progress in government markets.

title: GraniteShares 2x Long NVDA Daily ETF
summary: This article provides a detailed profile of the GraniteShares 2x Long NVDA Daily ETF (NVDL), offering comprehensive data on its price, dividends, expenses, holdings, and performance. It compares NVDL to alternative ETFs within its category and segment, highlighting key metrics like expense ratio, assets under management, and returns. The profile also includes technical analysis, volatility data, and recent news relevant to the ETF.

title: [Latest] Global E-Learning Market Size/Share Worth USD 848.1 Billion by 2030 at a 17.53% CAGR: Custom Market Insights (Analysis, Outlook, Leaders, Report, Trends, Forecast, Segmentation, Growth, Growth Rate, Value)
summary: The global E-Learning market, valued at approximately USD 210 Billion in 2021, is projected to reach USD 848.1 Billion by 2030, exhibiting a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 17.53% between 2022 and 2030. Key drivers include increased e-learning adoption during the pandemic and technological advancements, while challenges involve data security concerns. The Learning Management System (LMS) technology and North America are noted as dominant segments within the market.

title: 5 Charts on Big Tech Stocks’ Collapse
summary: In 2022, Big Tech stocks collectively lost nearly $4 trillion in market value, with the Morningstar US Technology Index down 28.7%. This collapse significantly impacted overall market returns, contributing 7 percentage points to the U.S. market index's 18.7% loss. Factors like recession fears, advertising slowdowns, and changes in consumer spending led to substantial declines for companies such as Meta Platforms, Amazon, Alphabet, Microsoft, and Nvidia.

title: Microsoft and Viasat Partner to Provide Satellite Internet Services to Underrepresented Communities in Africa
summary: Microsoft and Viasat have partnered to provide satellite internet services to 10 million people globally, including 5 million across Africa by 2025, through Microsoft's Airband initiative. The project, which begins in Angola, Egypt, and Senegal, aims to bridge the digital divide by offering telehealth, distance learning, and other services. This collaboration also leverages the existing relationship between Viasat and Microsoft Azure Space to enhance satellite connectivity and address the lack of internet access in Africa, where simplified licensing procedures are facilitating global companies' efforts.

title: Australia takes aim at Apple, Microsoft over child protection online
summary: Australia's e-Safety Commissioner has accused Apple and Microsoft of not doing enough to combat child exploitation on their platforms. Following legal demands for information, the regulator found that neither company proactively screens for child abuse material in their cloud storage services, iCloud and OneDrive, nor do they detect live-streaming of child sexual abuse on video services like Skype, Microsoft Teams, and FaceTime. The Commissioner deemed their responses "alarming" and highlighted a "major step backwards" after Apple announced it would stop scanning iCloud accounts for child abuse.

title: Microsoft announces the phased rollout of the EU Data Boundary for the Microsoft Cloud begins January 1, 2023
summary: Microsoft is initiating a phased rollout of its EU Data Boundary solution for public sector and commercial customers in the EU and EFTA starting January 1, 2023. This service enhancement will allow customers to store and process their data within the EU Data Boundary for Microsoft 365, Azure, Power Platform, and Dynamics 365, significantly reducing data flows outside of Europe. Microsoft also plans to provide detailed transparency documentation and a roadmap to assist customers with planning for this industry-leading data residency solution.

title: Another music streaming service is making its own AI-generated songs – and it’s on course to create over 200,000 of them.
summary: Anghami, a MENA-focused music streaming service, has partnered with Mubert to generate over 200,000 AI-generated songs, primarily for "musical football cheers" during the FIFA World Cup. This initiative uses Mubert's generative music technology, which combines samples from human musicians with AI, and Anghami's user data to create personalized tracks. The project highlights a growing trend among streaming platforms and tech companies like Tencent Music Entertainment and ByteDance in developing and hosting AI-created music.

title: Four Retention Strategies to Avoid Tech Talent Turnover
summary: This article outlines four key strategies for retaining tech talent amidst the current competitive landscape. It emphasizes valuing technologists' time, fostering innovation through appropriate tools, ensuring employees feel heard, and building a team-centric culture. The strategies aim to create an environment where tech professionals want to join and stay, thereby reducing turnover and its associated costs and impacts on organizational goals.

title: Want to Attract Top Tech Talent? Prioritize Their Needs
summary: This article emphasizes that attracting and retaining top tech talent requires more than just competitive pay; companies must prioritize technologists' needs for growth, modern tools, and an inclusive work environment. It suggests strategies like clear communication during recruiting, investing in up-to-date technologies, and fostering a culture of acceptance and work-life quality. Ultimately, understanding and acting on these priorities will help businesses thrive in the competitive tech talent market.

title: Microsoft names new Chief Sustainability Officer
summary: Microsoft has appointed Melanie Nakagawa as its new Chief Sustainability Officer, reporting directly to President & Vice Chair Brad Smith. Nakagawa, with nearly two decades of experience in environmental sustainability, will lead Microsoft's company-wide environmental initiatives, focusing on achieving carbon negative, water positive, and zero waste goals by 2030, accelerating innovation for customers, and partnering with external organizations for global sustainability progress. Her appointment comes as Microsoft accelerates its sustainability efforts amid increasing global climate challenges discussed at COP27.

title: Tech: Micron looks past semiconductor downturn for opportunities, ramps up investment in Penang
summary: Micron Technology Inc. is navigating a semiconductor downturn characterized by inventory adjustments and weakened consumer demand but sees significant long-term growth opportunities driven by data-intensive technologies like AI and 5G. Despite current challenges, Micron is ramping up its investment in Penang, Malaysia, with an additional US$1 billion planned for a second factory, bringing its total investment in the Batu Kawan site to US$2 billion. The company emphasizes Malaysia's crucial role as a Centre of Excellence for its assembly and test operations and its commitment to continued expansion in the region.

title: WisdomTree Launches Quality Growth ETF, QGRW
summary: WisdomTree Investments has launched a new quality growth ETF, the WisdomTree U.S. Quality Growth Fund (QGRW), which tracks a market-cap-weighted index focusing on growth and quality factors. This new offering aims to avoid speculative growth names while including firms with strong growth signals, similar to their dividend growth fund DGRW. QGRW has a 28 basis point fee and includes major companies like Apple, Microsoft, and Amazon in its top holdings, starting with $1.3 million in AUM.

title: MSCI ONE Aims to Help Investors Turn Data Into Insights
summary: MSCI Inc. has launched MSCI ONE, an open architecture technology platform built on Microsoft Azure, designed to help investors convert vast amounts of data into actionable insights for investment decisions. The platform provides next-generation quantitative investment analytics through a modern web-based experience, combining flexible distribution, cloud delivery, dashboards, and visualizations. MSCI ONE offers single-point access to various services like MSCI Risk Insights, Climate Solutions, and its Developer Community, emphasizing improved client experience through transformational technology.

title: OpwnAI: AI That Can Save the Day or HACK it Away
summary: Check Point Research explored the dual nature of AI, specifically OpenAI's ChatGPT and Codex, in the cybersecurity landscape. They demonstrated how these AI models can be leveraged by threat actors to create a full infection flow, from phishing emails to running reverse shells, without writing a single line of code. Conversely, the article also highlighted AI's potential to assist defenders and threat hunters in automating and improving their work through code generation for security tasks.

title: Apple CIO steps down from Rackspace board citing new job duties
summary: Rackspace Technology announced that Apple CIO Tim Campos resigned from its board of directors, effective December 12, due to new job duties and potential conflicts of interest. This change comes amidst a series of management restructurings at Rackspace and their ongoing recovery from a recent ransomware attack on their Hosted Exchange business, which impacted thousands of small- and medium-sized businesses. The company is actively focusing on recovering impacted email data and transitioning affected customers to Microsoft 365, while also making other executive changes.

title: T-Mobile Supports 5G Rollout with Azure Synapse Analytics and Power BI
summary: T-Mobile leveraged Microsoft Azure Synapse Analytics and Power BI to build a robust data lakehouse solution, significantly improving its data reporting and decision-making capabilities for its nationwide 5G network rollout. This centralized data architecture allowed T-Mobile to overcome challenges with disparate data sources, streamline supply chain and business-critical information, and enhance security and performance. The integration of Power BI with Azure facilitated the creation of powerful dashboards, enabling data-driven insights for procurement and supply chain management and supporting both strategic and operational users.

title: Microsoft named a Leader in the 2022 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Global Industrial IoT Platforms
summary: Microsoft has been recognized as a Leader in the 2022 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Global Industrial IoT Platforms for the third consecutive year. The article highlights Microsoft's continued innovation and investment in industrial IoT, emphasizing key areas such as IT/OT convergence, cloud and on-site innovations, digital twins and the metaverse, security advancements, and collaborations with partners. Microsoft's Azure IoT platform aims to help industries improve operations to become more efficient, agile, and sustainable.

title: NetApp Develops Software to Unify Hybrid Multicloud Management
summary: NetApp has released BlueXP software, a unified control plane designed to simplify hybrid multicloud management for companies by automating operations across on-premises and public cloud environments. This new offering aims to address the complexity of modern diverse IT landscapes, providing a single point of visibility and management for various storage assets. BlueXP integrates an AIOps engine, AI-enabled health monitoring, advanced security features including a ransomware dashboard, and a pay-per-play model with NetApp Keystone services.

title: Gaming peripheral market size to increase by USD 5,610.35 million: APAC will account for 35% of the market's growth during the forecast period - Technavio
summary: The global gaming peripheral market is projected to grow by USD 5,610.35 million at a CAGR of 9.41% during the forecast period. The Asia-Pacific (APAC) region is expected to contribute 35% of this growth, driven by an increase in gamers adopting gaming as a career. Key market drivers include the rising popularity of e-sports and advanced gaming consoles, while challenges include counterfeit products and high peripheral costs.

title: Kyndryl Receives Recognitions from ISG and Gartner® for Managed Network Services
summary: Kyndryl has been recognized by leading analyst firms ISG and Gartner for its network solutions and managed network services, just one year after becoming an independent company. This recognition highlights Kyndryl's growth strategy, advanced delivery, and strategic alliances with key partners like hyperscalers, Nokia, Intel, Cisco, and Vodafone. The company emphasizes its commitment to reskilling employees and delivering next-generation network technologies, including private wireless, edge computing, and cloud networking, to drive business transformation for its customers.

title: Scale AI Named a 2022 Cool Vendor by Gartner®
summary: Scale AI, a data infrastructure provider for artificial intelligence, has been recognized as a 2022 Cool Vendor in Data-Centric AI by Gartner. The company offers AI solutions and machine learning tools that help organizations overcome challenges related to resources, talent, and high-quality data in AI implementation, operationalizing AI for various sectors including government, research, and Fortune 500 companies. This recognition underscores Scale AI's commitment to accelerating AI development and providing impactful AI solutions based on high-quality data.

title: CISA Alert: Top 15 Routinely Exploited Vulnerabilities
summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity & Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has released its 2021 report on the top 15 routinely exploited vulnerabilities, highlighting common targets like internet-facing systems and the rapid release of proof-of-concept code. This article summarizes CISA's findings, detailing critical vulnerabilities such as Log4Shell, ProxyShell, and ProxyLogon. It also explains how Qualys VMDR can help organizations detect, prioritize, and remediate these threats efficiently.

title: Ken Griffin among world’s richest after stellar year for Citadel
summary: Ken Griffin, CEO of Citadel, has joined the ranks of the world's top 40 wealthiest individuals following an exceptional year for his hedge fund, with its flagship Wellington fund returning 32%. This success comes despite a challenging market for other financial institutions and amid accusations of market manipulation ("spoofing") by biotech firm Northwest Biotherapeutics, which Citadel firmly denies. The firm's performance was reportedly boosted by strategic trading of S&P 500 options.

title: 7 Cybersecurity Stocks to Buy and Hold for the Long Haul
summary: This article identifies seven cybersecurity stocks and an ETF that investors should consider buying and holding for the long haul, despite the current tech downturn. The author emphasizes the increasing essentiality of cybersecurity for businesses and governments, projecting significant market growth. Featured companies include Palo Alto Networks, Microsoft, Palantir, Zscaler, CrowdStrike Holdings, and Fortinet, alongside the Global X Cybersecurity ETF (BUG).

title: Microsoft, Cisco Shareholder Votes Demonstrate Increasing Investor Demand for Tax and Offshore Transparency
summary: Shareholders of Microsoft and Cisco, representing hundreds of billions in investments, voted in favor of proposals calling for public country-by-country reporting on offshore operations and tax practices. This trend indicates growing investor demand for transparency regarding potential risks associated with opaque offshore activities. The FACT Coalition highlights that public country-by-country reporting is becoming inevitable due to global momentum and regulatory considerations in jurisdictions like the EU, Australia, and the U.S.

title: Infographic: Log4Shell Vulnerability Impact by the Numbers
summary: This article presents an infographic detailing the impact of the Log4Shell vulnerability based on a Qualys Research Team study. It highlights the widespread exposure across industries and the challenges in remediation, revealing enterprise IT's exposure and response across various criteria. The infographic covers threat landscape, vulnerability trends, remediation trends, and attack patterns, emphasizing the unprecedented nature of the Log4Shell risk.

title: Netflix stock is up 65% since July, but the company faces 5 big problems in 2023
summary: Despite Netflix stock's 65% surge since July, a Wall Street analyst warns of significant headwinds for the company in 2023, including slowing subscriber growth and pressure on average revenue per user (ARPU). The recent ad-supported tier launch has seen struggles, with low adoption and missed viewership guarantees to advertisers. Additionally, the analyst suggests that regulatory actions, exemplified by the FTC's antitrust lawsuit against Microsoft, could impact Netflix's future acquisition prospects and advertising technology commitments.

title: Indoor Location Application Platforms Market is Booming Worldwide | Microsoft, Juniper Networks, Google, Infsoft
summary: A new study by AMA Research evaluates the Global Indoor Location Application Platforms Market, forecasting its trends and market size up to 2027. Key players include Microsoft, Juniper Networks, and Google, among others. The market is driven by increasing applications across beacon and BLE tags, and the inefficiency of GPS indoors, with opportunities in RFID tags and demand for contact-tracing solutions.

title: Dundee-headquartered Insights Group posts strong growth results
summary: Dundee-headquartered Insights Group reported a significant post-pandemic financial rebound, with turnover increasing by 55% year-on-year to £66.5 million. This growth is attributed to the digital transformation of its learning and development products and strategic investments in employee well-being and digital offerings. The group, which includes Insights Learning and Development and Vidatec, works with major global companies and continues to expand its reach and innovation in people development and digital solutions.

title: How King and its Candy Crush IP will help Microsoft boost its mobile revenues
summary: Microsoft is attempting to convince the US FTC that its acquisition of Activision Blizzard would boost its mobile revenues significantly, with its share of global mobile gaming revenues potentially increasing from 0.3% to over 4%. A key driver of this growth is King, the developer behind Candy Crush, which was the largest contributor to Activision Blizzard's mobile growth in Q3 2022. While the FTC has filed a lawsuit to block the $68.7 billion deal over monopoly concerns, Microsoft argues that the acquisition of a single game studio cannot disrupt a highly competitive industry.

title: LolZarus: Lazarus Group Incorporating Lolbins into Campaigns
summary: Qualys Threat Research identified a new Lazarus Group campaign, dubbed "LolZarus," targeting the defense sector with employment phishing lures, specifically impersonating Lockheed Martin. The campaign utilizes "lolbins" (living off the land binaries) and novel shellcode execution techniques to establish persistent beacons, highlighting the evolving capabilities of the Lazarus Group. The article details the technical analysis of the phishing documents, macro content, and various lolbins employed, along with ATT&CK mapping and Indicators of Compromise.

title: 'WHAT… HAPPENED'? A look back on crypto's 'biggest year yet' (for fraud, hacks, implosions…)
summary: This article provides a comprehensive look back at the tumultuous year 2022 for the cryptocurrency market, detailing significant events such as major frauds, hacks, and implosions of key platforms and stablecoins. It covers a month-by-month breakdown of happenings, including initial high hopes for adoption, the Terra/LUNA collapse, the "Great Crypto Contagion" of June, the Ethereum Merge, and the eventual downfall of FTX and Sam Bankman-Fried. The author questions the common prediction of a "builders" year ahead, suggesting a contrarian outcome may still be possible.

title: How the industrial metaverse will transform manufacturing
summary: The industrial metaverse, leveraging virtual and augmented reality, is transforming manufacturing by enhancing training, collaboration, and the use of digital twins. Companies like Lincoln Electric are using VR for faster and more efficient welder training, while automotive manufacturers like Kia and Volvo are using metaverse technologies for remote design collaboration and virtual prototyping, significantly cutting down development time and costs. Despite challenges like high equipment costs and technical difficulties, the industrial metaverse is gaining traction, with its applications expected to expand beyond initial consumer-focused visions.

title: iShares MSCI ACWI Index Fund (ACWI) Stock Price, Holdings, Dividend Yield
summary: This article provides a detailed overview of the iShares MSCI ACWI Index Fund (ACWI), including its stock price, key statistics, top holdings, and dividend information. The report also includes performance metrics and historical data for ACWI.

title: Despite reports, HPE says it’s not holding acquisition talks with Nutanix
summary: Hewlett Packard Enterprise Co.
